title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City
english: An immigration enforcement agent shot and wounded a man during an operation in the Bronx, New York, on Thursday. Government officials claim the individual has a significant criminal history, while local leaders have expressed outrage and are demanding the release of body camera footage. Protesters have gathered to condemn the incident, raising serious concerns about how the agency conducts operations within the city.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በኒውዮርክ ከተማ ብሮንክስ አካባቢ በተካሄደ ዘመቻ፣ የስደተኞች ጉዳይ አስፈጻሚ ወኪል አንድን ሰው ተኩሶ አቁስሏል። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ግለሰቡ ከባድ የወንጀል ታሪክ እንዳለው ቢገልጹም፣ የአካባቢው መሪዎች ግን በድርጊቱ ከፍተኛ ቁጣቸውን በመግለጽ የሰውነት ካሜራ ምስሎች እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል። በአካባቢው የተሰባሰቡ ተቃዋሚዎችም ይህንን ድርጊት በማውገዝ፣ ኤጀንሲው በከተማዋ ውስጥ በሚያደርገው እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ጥያቄ አንስተዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa magaalaa Nuyuurkiitti, bakka Bronx jedhamutti, jilaan gargaartuu hojii godaantotaa nama tokko rasaasaan rukutee mureera. Mootummaan akka jedhutti namichi kun seenaa yakkaa ulfaataa kan qabu yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni naannichaa garuu gocha kana balaaleffachuun vidiyoon kaameraa qaamaa akka ifa ta'u gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni naannichatti walgahanii gocha kana kan morman yoo ta'u, hojiin ejansii kanaa magaalaa keessatti balaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Who is Dov Lando, the Israeli rabbi criticising Zionism?
english: Rabbi Dov Lando, a 96-year-old leader of a major ultra-Orthodox party in Israel’s ruling coalition, has sparked controversy by condemning Zionism as a source of harm to the Jewish people. In a leaked recording, he suggested that Jews might have been safer and better off without a state, arguing that Zionism provoked conflict with Arabs. These comments have created significant political tension ahead of Israel's upcoming elections, where the ultra-Orthodox community's influence remains a critical factor.
amharic: የ96 ዓመቱ ረቢ ዶቭ ላንዶ በእስራኤል ገዢ ጥምረት ውስጥ ያለ ትልቅ የሃይማኖት ቡድን መሪ ሲሆኑ፣ ጽዮናዊነት በአይሁድ ህዝብ ላይ ጥፋትን አምጥቷል በማለት ውዝግብ ፈጥረዋል። በተሰራጨ የድምጽ ቅጂ ላይ አይሁዶች መንግስት ሳይኖራቸው በተሻለ ሁኔታ ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ በመግለጽ የጽዮናዊነት አስተሳሰብ ከአረቦች ጋር ለተፈጠረው ግጭት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ይህ አስተያየት በእስራኤል የሃይማኖተኛ ማህበረሰብ ሚና በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በሚታይበት ወቅት፣ ከመጪው ምርጫ ጋር በተያያዘ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Rabbi Dov Lando, hoogganaa umrii 96 kan ta'an fi garee ultra-Orthodox mootummaa Israa'el keessatti dhiibbaa qabu kan hogganan, yaada 'Zionism' ilmaan Israa'el irratti balaa fide jechuun kanneen biroo irratti mormii kaasan. Sagaleen isaa maxxanfame irratti, Yihuudonni biyya ofii qabaachuu mannaa, mootummaa malee jiraachuu akka danda'an fi Zionism kunis diinummaa Arabaa wajjin akka hammaate dubbataniiru. Yaanni kun filannoo Israa'el kan dhufuuf jiru irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira, keessattuu gaheen hawaasa amantii kun siyaasa biyyattii keessatti bakka guddaa waan qabuuf.

title: Afghanistan’s emerald miners struggle with tools but attract global buyers
english: Miners in Afghanistan’s Panjshir valley are using basic, manual tools to extract high-quality emeralds that are in high demand from international buyers. Despite the harsh working conditions and lack of modern equipment, these gemstones have become a vital economic lifeline for thousands of locals. Recent government-led auctions have generated millions of dollars, helping to boost state revenue in an economy struggling with poverty and sanctions.
amharic: በአፍጋኒስታን ፓንጅሺር ሸለቆ የሚገኙ ማዕድን አውጪዎች ጥራት ያላቸውን ኤመራልድ ድንጋዮች ለመቆፈር አሁንም ድረስ በእጅ የሚሰሩ ቀላል መሳሪያዎችን ይጠቀማሉ። እነዚህ የከበሩ ድንጋዮች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ያላቸው በመሆኑ ለሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዋና የገቢ ምንጭ ሆነዋል። መንግስት በሚያካሂዳቸው ጨረታዎች አማካኝነት በየዓመቱ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር ገቢ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በኢኮኖሚ ችግር እና በ ማዕቀብ ውስጥ ለሚገኘው አፍጋኒስታን ትልቅ ድጋፍ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni baay'ee lafa Panjshir, Afganistaan keessa jiran, dhagaa gati-jabeessa 'emeraaldii' jedhamu baasuuf meeshaalee salphaa fi harka qofa fayyadamu. Dhagaan kun qulqullina olaanaa waan qabuuf, gabaa idil-addunyaa irratti barbaadamaa fi bu'uura jireenyaa namoota kumaatamaan lakkaa'amaniif ta'eera. Mootummaan wayita ammaa gabaa kana gurmeessuun mallaqa miliyoonaan lakkaa'amu argachaa jiru; kunis biyyattii koroopshinii fi sagantaa dhiibbaa diinagdee jala jirtuuf gargaarsa guddaa ta'eera.

title: Trump says US will not strike Iran before midterm elections
english: President Donald Trump has officially stated that the United States will not launch any military strikes against Iran before the midterm elections on November 3. This announcement was aimed at easing regional tensions, leading to a noticeable drop in global oil prices. Meanwhile, both nations continue to engage in diplomatic discussions, even as reports of naval incidents in the Strait of Hormuz persist.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ እስከ ህዳር 3 ቀን በሚካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ድረስ በኢራን ላይ ምንም ዓይነት ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደማትሰነዝር አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ በክልሉ የነበረውን ውጥረት በማርገብ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። በሌላ በኩል ሁለቱ ሀገራት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ድርድር እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ የሚከሰቱ የባህር ኃይል እንቅስቃሴዎች ስጋት እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, Ameerikaan hanga filannoo giddu-galeessaa Sadaasa 3tti Iran irratti haleellaa waraanaa akka hin banne beeksisaniiru. Ibsi kun yaaddoo naannichaa hir'isuun gatiin boba'aa akka gad-bu'u godheera. Gama biraatiin, biyyoonni lameen karaa diippilomaasiitiin marii godhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, ta'us naannoo galaana Hormuzitti sochiiwwan waraanaa mudachaa jiranuun sodaan jiraachuun ibsameera.

title: Brazilian Supreme Court judge issues arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro
english: A Brazilian Supreme Court judge has ordered the arrest of Eduardo Bolsonaro, the son of the former president, following his conviction for illegally lobbying the US to interfere in Brazilian judicial matters. Currently living in the United States, Bolsonaro faces a four-year prison sentence, and the court has revoked his passport to prevent him from escaping justice. This legal development occurs just weeks before a high-stakes presidential runoff election, further intensifying the political tension in the country.
amharic: የብራዚል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ዳኛ የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ልጅ የሆኑትን ኤድዋርዶ ቦልሶናሮን በቁጥጥር ስር እንዲውሉ ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። ኤድዋርዶ ቦልሶናሮ በብራዚል የፍርድ ሂደት ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንዲገቡ አሜሪካን በመለመን ጥፋተኛ ሆነው በመገኘታቸው የአራት ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩት ኤድዋርዶ፣ ወደ ብራዚል እንዳይገቡ ፓስፖርታቸው ተሰርዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ የሀገሪቱን የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር እየተካሄደ ባለበት ወቅት ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa mana murtii olaanaa Biraazil ilma duraanii pirezidaantii kan ta'an Eduardo Bolsonaro, dhimma seerummaa Biraazil keessatti akka gidduu seenan Amerikaa kadhachuu isaaniitiin erga yakka itti muramee booda akka hidhaman ajajeera. Yeroo ammaa Amerikaa jiraatanis, Bolsonaro hidhaa waggaa afurii kan eeggatu yoo ta'u, mana murtichis biyyatti akka hin deebineef paspoortii isaanii haqee jira. Murtiin kun filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyyattii kan lammaffaa dhiyaatee jiru keessatti, morkii siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti kaka'umsa guddaa uumee jira.

title: From Aden to Sanaa, Yemenis struggle to deal with soaring living costs
english: Yemen is facing a severe economic crisis as ongoing conflict and a divided financial system drive up living costs. Many citizens are struggling to afford basic necessities because salaries are either unpaid or insufficient to cover the rising prices of food and rent. This long-term instability has significantly reduced the quality of life for millions of people across the country.
amharic: የየመን ህዝብ ቀጣይነት ባለው ግጭት እና በተከፋፈለ የፋይናንስ ስርዓት ሳቢያ የኑሮ ውድነት ተግዳሮት እየገጠመው ይገኛል። ደመወዝ ባለመከፈሉ ወይም በቂ ባለመሆኑ በርካታ ዜጎች የምግብ እና የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋን መሸፈን ተስኗቸዋል። ይህ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየው የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ የየመን ነዋሪዎችን የኑሮ ደረጃ ክፉኛ ጎድቷል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni itti fufee fi sirni baankii gargar hiramee jiru gatiin jireenyaa akka olka'u godheera. Hojjettoonni mindaa hin arganne ykn mindaan isaanii gatii nyaataa fi kiree manaaf ga'aa waan hin taaneef, namoonni baay'een jireenya guyyaa guyyaa isaanii jiraachuuf rakkachaa jiru. Rakkoon dinagdee kun waggoota dheeraaf itti fufee waan jiruuf, namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: Morning update
english: The IRGC Navy reports it is actively monitoring and policing the Strait of Hormuz, while the U.S. has returned the USS Abraham Lincoln to San Diego following a lengthy deployment. Meanwhile, the Gaza conflict continues with significant civilian casualties and destruction reported. Diplomatic efforts are ongoing, with Russia pledging assistance for peace and the U.S. imposing new sanctions on Iran's oil shipping network.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ የባህር ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እያደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቋል፤ የአሜሪካው አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ USS Abraham Lincoln ረጅም ተልእኮውን አጠናቆ ወደ አገሩ ተመልሷል። በሌላ በኩል በጋዛ የሚካሄደው ጦርነት አሁንም ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እየቀጠፈ ይገኛል። ሩሲያ በካይሮ እና በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ሰላም እንዲሰፍን ጥረት እንደምታደርግ የገለጸች ሲሆን አሜሪካ በበኩሏ በኢራን የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መርከቦች ላይ አዲስ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች።
oromo: Humnoonni galaana Iran kan IRGC yeroo ammaa qarqara galaana Hormuz to'achaa jiraachuu ibsaniiru, akkasumas dooniin waraana Amerikaa USS Abraham Lincoln erga waggaa tokkoof deemsa waraanaa erga raawwatee booda gara buufata isaa deebi'eera. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Gaza itti fufee lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachaa jira. Prezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vladimir Putin nagaa buusuuf gumaacha akka godhan waadaa seenan, yeroo kanatti immoo Ameerikaan dooniiwwan boba'aa Iran irratti kaffaltii fi adabbii haaraa dabsiteetti.

title: October 7th never ended for Gaza, Palestinian journalist says
english: Journalist Mahmoud Mushtaha argues that the events following October 7th are still ongoing in Gaza rather than being a past anniversary. He reports that the humanitarian situation continues to deteriorate due to persistent military strikes, land occupation, and severe restrictions on essential aid. Because of these unrelenting conditions, he emphasizes that the residents have no opportunity to find closure or move forward.
amharic: ጋዜጠኛ ማህሙድ ሙሽታሃ ጥቅምት 7 ቀን የተከሰተው ክስተት ያለፈ ታሪክ ሳይሆን አሁንም በጋዛ እየቀጠለ ያለ ቀውስ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል። ቀጣይነት ባለው ወታደራዊ ጥቃት፣ የምድር ወረራ እና ለዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ዕርዳታዎች መከልከል ምክንያት የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች ሁኔታ እያሽቆለቆለ መምጣቱን አስረድቷል። በእነዚህ አስከፊ ሁኔታዎች ምክንያት የጋዛ ህዝብ ከጦርነቱ መዘዝ ለመላቀቅ እና ወደ መደበኛ ህይወት ለመመለስ ምንም አይነት እድል እንደሌለው ተናግሯል።
oromo: Gaazexeessaan Mahaamud Mushtahaa akka jedhutti, mudannoon Onkololeessa 7 badii darbee kan yaadatamu osoo hin taane, har'as gaazaa keessatti itti fufee kan jiru balaadha. Sababa weerara waraanaa, lafa humnaan qabachuu fi gargaarsa namoomaa dhowwachuun haalli jireenyaa jiraattotaa guyyaa guyyaan hammaachaa akka jiru ibseera. Sababa rakkoolee cimaa kanaatiin, namoonni achi jiraatan jireenya isaanii gara duriitti deebisuuf carraa akka hin qabne ibsameera.

title: Iranian lawmaker says Tehran not seeking production of nuclear weapons
english: Iranian official Alaeddin Boroujerdi has denied that Tehran is pursuing nuclear weapons, emphasizing that their program follows international treaties. This statement responds to US Vice President JD Vance, who recently urged Iran to significantly lower its uranium enrichment levels as a condition for diplomatic progress. While Iran maintains its activities are peaceful, the US continues to demand verifiable actions rather than just verbal assurances regarding their nuclear program.
amharic: የኢራኑ ህግ አውጪ አላዲን ቦሩጄርዲ፣ ቴህራን የኑክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ ለመስራት እንደማትፈልግ በመግለጽ የሀገሪቱ የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም ከአለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶች ጋር የሚጣጣም መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ኢራን የኑክሌር ማበልጸጊያ አቅሟን እንድትቀንስ መጠየቃቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። ኢራን ስራዋ ሰላማዊ እንደሆነ ስትገልጽ፣ አሜሪካ ግን በአባባል ብቻ ሳይሆን በተግባር የሚታይ ለውጥ እንደምትፈልግ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, biyyattii meeshaa niwukileraa oomishuuf karoora hin qabdu; akkasumas sagantaan isaanii kan bu'uureffate waliigaltee idil-addunyaa irratti akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kennamee erga itti aanaa pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, Iran karoora ishee kana akka hir'iftu gaafatanii booda. Iran hojiin ishee nageenyaaf akka ta'e kan ibsitu yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan garuu jecha qofa osoo hin taane tarkaanfii qabatamaa akka barbaaddu ibsiteetti.

title: Pakistani premier condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
english: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has publicly denounced recent Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, which caused civilian casualties at major airports. Sharif reaffirmed Pakistan’s firm support for the kingdom’s security and sovereignty, citing their mutual defense agreements. He demanded an immediate end to the violence and praised Saudi forces for their efforts to intercept incoming missiles.
amharic: የፓኪስታኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼህባዝ ሻሪፍ በሳውዲ አረቢያ አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ባለው የመከላከያ ስምምነት መሰረት የሳውዲን ሉዓላዊነትና ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ፓኪስታን ከጎናቸው እንደምትቆም አረጋግጠዋል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃታቸውን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ የጠየቁት ሻሪፍ፣ የሳውዲ የጸጥታ ሃይሎች ሚሳኤሎችን በመከልከል ያሳዩትን ብቃት አድንቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Paakistaan Shehbaaz Shaariif haleellaa gareen Huutii buufataalee xiyyaaraa Saudii Arabaa irratti raawwate cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Shaariif akka jedhanitti, Paakistaan waliigaltee ittisaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiruun walqabatee, nageenyaa fi kabajamuu daangaa Saudii Arabaaf gargaarsa guutuu kennitu. Haleellaa kana akka hatattamaan dhaaban garee Huutiif akeekkachiisa dabarsuun, waraanni Saudii haleellaa kana ittisuuf carraaqqii godhe dinqisiifataniiru.

title: Over 200 organisations set to join 'Global Day of Action' for Palestine
english: More than 200 international organizations are planning a coordinated day of protest this Saturday to support Palestine. Groups from 60 countries, including labor unions and student networks, aim to move beyond traditional demonstrations by using civil intervention to challenge complicity in the conflict. The organizers are calling for systemic accountability regarding Israel's actions in Gaza.
amharic: ከ200 የሚበልጡ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ለፍልስጤም ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመግለጽ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በተቀናጀ መልኩ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ ለማድረግ ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀዋል። ከ60 በላይ አገራት የተውጣጡ የሲቪል ማህበረሰብ፣ የሠራተኛ ማህበራት እና የተማሪዎች ቡድኖች በዚህ እንቅስቃሴ ይሳተፋሉ። አዘጋጆቹ ድርጊታቸው ከወትሮው የተለየ እና በጋዛ ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት ተጠያቂነትን የሚጠይቅ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa 200 ol ta'an, Roobii darbe akka beeksisanitti, guyyaa Sanbataa kana deeggarsa Filisxeemii ibsuuf hiriira waloo ta'e gaggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Biyyoota 60 keessaa gareen hawaasaa, gamtaan hojjettootaa fi barattoonni hiriira kana irratti kan hirmaatan yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaanii tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuun yakka waraanaa fi ajjeechaa sanyii irratti gaaffii itti gaafatamummaa kaasuudha.

title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
english: A former Ukrainian security officer, Vitalii Zhykovych, has spoken to the BBC from prison regarding his alleged involvement in a June bomb attack in Monaco against a wealthy businessman. Zhykovych claims the operation was orchestrated by senior members of Ukraine's military intelligence agency, HUR, and disputes accusations that he murdered the woman who planted the bomb. While the primary suspect in the explosion, Anastasia Berezovska, was later found dead, Zhykovych insists he did not order the attack and points to an intelligence officer named Vladyslav Reut as the person who authorized the mission.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዩክሬን የደህንነት መኮንን ቪታሊ ዚኮቪች በሞናኮ ውስጥ ባለሀብት ላይ የተፈጸመውን የቦምብ ጥቃት በተመለከተ ከእስር ቤት ሆኖ ለቢቢሲ መግለጫ ሰጥቷል። ዚኮቪች ጥቃቱ የታቀደው በዩክሬን ወታደራዊ መረጃ ኤጀንሲ (HUR) ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት እንደሆነና ቦምቡን የጣለችውን ሴት በመግደል የተከሰሰውን ክስ እንደማይቀበል ተናግሯል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው አናስታሲያ ቤሬዞቭስካ ከጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ሞታ የተገኘች ሲሆን፣ ዚኮቪች ራሱ ጥቃቱን እንዳላዘዘ እና ለኦፕሬሽኑ ዋና ተጠያቂው የደህንነት መኮንኑ ቭላዲላቭ ሬውት መሆኑን አስረድቷል።
oromo: Ajajaa nageenyaa duraanii kan Yukreen Vitalii Zhykovich, ji'a Waxabajjii darbe Monakootti nama dureessa tokko irratti haleellaa boombii gaggeeffame irratti hirmaachuun isaa himamee, mana hidhaa taa'ee BBC'f ibsa kenneera. Zhykovich haleellaan kun kan qindeeffame qaamolee olaanoo raayyaa ittisa biyyattii (HUR) irraa akka ta'ee fi dubartii boombichaa dhaabde ajjeese jedhamee himannaa dhihaateef akka hin fudhanne ibseera. Dubartiin boombicha dhaabde jedhamtu Anastasia Berezovska yeroo gabaabaa booda duutee kan argamte yoo ta'u, Zhykovich haleellicha akka hin ajajnee fi itti gaafatamaan inni guddaan qondaala nageenyaa Vladyslav Reut akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
english: The U.S. Pentagon has announced that the execution of Nidal Hasan, responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, will be broadcast via livestream. This event marks the first military execution by firing squad in over 60 years, with officials stating it is intended to demonstrate the severe consequences of such crimes. The execution is scheduled to take place on December 3 in Texas.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር በ2009 በፎርት ሁድ የጦር ሰፈር ጥቃት የፈጸመውን ኒዳል ሀሰንን በጥይት የመቅጣት ሂደት በቀጥታ ስርጭት እንደሚተላለፍ አስታውቋል። ይህ ከ60 ዓመታት በላይ በወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት የሚከናወን የመጀመሪያው የግድያ ቅጣት ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ ለከባድ ወንጀሎች የሚወሰደውን ቅጣት ለማሳየት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ግድያው ታህሳስ 3 ቀን በቴክሳስ ግዛት ይፈጸማል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Amerikaa, nama bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Fort Hood irratti ajjeechaa raawwate Nidal Hasan, adabbiin du'aa isaa dhukaasaan raawwatamu karaa viidiyoo qajeelaa (livestream) akka darbu beeksiseera. Kun waggaa 60 oliif waraana keessatti adabbiin du'aa akkanaa yommuu raawwatamu yeroo jalqabaati; hoogganoonnis tarkiinichi yakka akkanaa irratti adabbiin cimaan akka jiru agarsiisuuf akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Adabbiin kun Muddee 3, Texas keessatti akka raawwatamuuf karoorfameera.

title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
english: Adidas has initiated legal action against the Australian fashion brand White Fox for allegedly copying its iconic three-stripe trademark. The sportswear giant claims that White Fox's use of a four-stripe design is confusingly similar and falsely suggests a partnership between the two companies. Adidas is now seeking financial damages and a permanent stop to the sale of the disputed clothing items.
amharic: አዲዳስ ታዋቂውን የሶስት መስመር ምልክቱን በመቅዳት የአውስትራሊያውን የፋሽን ኩባንያ ዋይት ፎክስ ክስ መስርቶበታል። የስፖርት ልብስ አምራቹ ኩባንያ ዋይት ፎክስ የሚጠቀምበት የአራት መስመር ዲዛይን የደንበኞችን አእምሮ ግራ የሚያጋባ እና በሁለቱ ኩባንያዎች መካከል ግንኙነት እንዳለ የሚያሳይ ነው ሲል ይከራከራል። አዲዳስ ከዚህ ውዝግብ ጋር በተያያዘ የገንዘብ ካሳ እንዲከፈለውና የተከራካሪው ኩባንያ ምርቶቹን ለገበያ ማቅረቡ እንዲቆም ጠይቋል።
oromo: Adidas bittaa fi gurgurtaa uffataa irratti mallattoo isaanii kan yeroo dheeraa beekame 'goda sadii' jedhamu kan fayyadamuuf, dhaabbata uffata baasuu Awustraaliyaa White Fox irratti himata seeraa baneera. Adidas, White Fox mallattoo isaanii fakkaatu kan 'goda afur' fayyadamuun isaa maamiltoota burjaajessuufi hariiroo hin jirre kan uumu ta'uu ibseera. Kanneen keessaa, Adidas gatii miidhaa irra ga'eef kaffaltii barbaaduu cinaatti, White Fox uffata mallattoo kana qaban gurguruu akka dhaabu gaafateera.

title: USS Abraham Lincoln returns after record-breaking deployment
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln has officially returned to San Diego following a challenging mission that lasted over 300 days. While families celebrated the homecoming, the extended deployment resulted in significant difficulties, including equipment failures, supply issues, and reports of mental health crises among the crew. The vessel had been deployed to support American military operations involving Iran.
amharic: የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ከ300 ቀናት በላይ በባህር ላይ ከቆየ ረጅም ተልእኮ በኋላ ወደ ሳንዲያጎ ተመልሷል። የቤተሰብ አባላት አቀባበል ቢያደርጉላቸውም፣ ረጅሙ የቆይታ ጊዜ በመርከቧ ላይ የነበሩ ወታደሮች የቁሳቁስ እጥረት፣ የመሳሪያ ብልሽት እና የአእምሮ ጤና ችግሮች እንዲያጋጥሟቸው አድርጓል። መርከቧ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ለነበረው የጦርነት እንቅስቃሴ ድጋፍ ስትሰጥ ነበር የቆየችው።
oromo: Dooniin waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamtu, duula guyyoota 300 ol fudhate booda gara San Diego deebiteetti. Maatiin loltootaa gammachuun kan simatan ta’us, yeroon dheeraan doonii keessatti dabarsan kun rakkoolee akka hanqina meeshaalee, miidhaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi rakkoo sammuu loltoota irratti uumamee ture. Dooniin kun kan bobbaafamte waraana Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture gargaaruuf ture.

title: UN extends Darfur arms embargo, blocks broader Sudan sanctions proposal
english: The United Nations Security Council has decided to extend the existing arms embargo on Sudan's Darfur region for two months. While the United States pushed to expand these restrictions across the entire country, the proposal was blocked by Russia and China. Consequently, the current measures will remain limited to Darfur while diplomatic discussions continue.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት በሱዳን ዳርፉር ክልል ላይ የተጣለውን የጦር መሳሪያ ማዕቀብ ለሁለት ወራት ለማራዘም ወስኗል። አሜሪካ ማዕቀቡን ወደ መላው የሱዳን ግዛት ለማስፋት ያቀረበችው ጥያቄ በሩሲያ እና በቻይና ተቃውሞ ውድቅ ተደርጓል። በዚህም ምክንያት የነባሩ ማዕቀብ አፈጻጸም ዳርፉር ላይ ብቻ ተወስኖ እንዲቀጥል ተወስኗል።
oromo: Mootummoota Gamtoomaniif gorsi nageenyaa dhimma hidhannoo naannoo Daarfuur irratti kanaan dura ture ji'oota lamaaf akka dheeratu murteesseera. Ameerikaan dhiibbaa kana guutummaa biyyattii irratti babal'isuuf yaaltee turteellee, biyyoonni Ruusiyaa fi Chaayinaan mormuun isaanii yaada kana fudhatama dhabsiiseera. Kanaafuu, dhimmi kun haala kanaan dura ture irratti hundaa'ee naannoo Daarfuur qofaaf akka itti fufu ta'eera.

title: USS Lincoln returns to US after long deployment supporting war on Iran
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln has returned to San Diego after a record-breaking 265-day continuous deployment supporting the US-Israel conflict against Iran. The mission faced significant scrutiny due to reports of poor onboard conditions, food shortages, and mental health struggles among the exhausted crew. While the administration dismissed these criticisms as media bias, the deployment remains a contentious symbol of the prolonged and straining military campaign.
amharic: የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ኢራን ላይ በሚያካሂዱት ጦርነት ተሳትፎ ካደረገ በኋላ ወደ ሳንዲያጎ መሠረቱ ተመልሷል። መርከቧ በተከታታይ ለ265 ቀናት በባህር ላይ በመቆየቷ ረጅም ጊዜ ያስመዘገበች ሲሆን፣ በቆይታዋ ወቅት ስለተከሰቱ የምግብ እጥረት፣ አስቸጋሪ የኑሮ ሁኔታ እና የሠራተኞች የአእምሮ ጤና መቃወስ ዘገባዎች ተሰምተዋል። የአሜሪካ መንግሥት እነዚህን ዘገባዎች የውሸት ሲል ውድቅ ቢያደርጋቸውም፣ ረጅም ጊዜ የፈጀው ይህ ተልዕኮ በጦርነቱ ላይ ያለውን ስጋት የሚያሳይ ሆኗል።
oromo: Dooniin waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamu, waraana Ameerikaafi Israa'el Itoophiyaa waliin ta'uun Iran irratti gaggeessaa jiran deeggaraa erga turee booda gara buufata isaa San Diyaagoo deebi'eera. Dooniin kun guyyoota 265 walitti aansuudhaan galaana irra turuun seenaa hojii dheeraa galmeessee jira. Yeroo kana keessatti haala jireenyaa rakkisaa, hanqina nyaataa fi rakkoolee fayyaa sammuu hojjettoota isaa irratti mudateen walqabatee gabaasni hedduun ba'aa turan; bulchiinsi Ameerikaas gabaasa kana mormuun hojiin isaanii kan milkaa'e ta'uu ibsee jira.

title: A father’s agony after an Israeli air strike hits Gaza apartment
english: An Israeli air strike on a residential building in Gaza City's al-Sabra district has resulted in the tragic deaths of several civilians, including sleeping children. This incident highlights the ongoing violence in the region, where over 1,400 Palestinians have lost their lives since October 2025 despite an announced ceasefire. A grieving father is now mourning his family members following this devastating attack.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በአል-ሳብራ ሰፈር በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ላይ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት፣ ተኝተው የነበሩ ሕፃናትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሲቪሎች ተገድለዋል። በጥቅምት 2025 ተኩስ አቁም መታወጁ ቢነገርም፣ ከዚያ ጊዜ ወዲህ ከ1,400 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸውን መረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት የቤተሰብ አባላቱን ያጣ አንድ አባት ከፍተኛ ሀዘን ውስጥ እንዲወድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Humni qilleensaa Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti gamoo iddoo jireenyaa tokko irratti miidhaa geessiseen, ijoollee hirriiba irra turan dabalatee namoonni hedduun ajjeefamaniiru. Adoolessa 2025 keessa labsiin dhuka-dhaabbiin kan labsame ta'us, yeroo sanaa as namoonni Falasxiin 1,400 ol ta'an lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Miidhaa suukaneessaa kanaan abbaan tokko maatii isaa dhabee gaddaan miidhamuun isaa gabaafameera.

title: Will Ethiopia’s neighbours intervene as Tigray war escalates?
english: Ethiopian federal forces have regained control of the regional capital, Mekelle, following intense combat that effectively collapsed the 2022 ceasefire. While the rebel groups have retreated to the countryside to continue their resistance, the conflict risks intensifying due to the reported involvement of Eritrean troops. This renewed instability has raised regional tensions, as neighboring countries remain concerned about how Ethiopia's internal military maneuvers might impact broader geopolitical interests.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የፌዴራል መንግስት ኃይሎች ከባድ ውጊያ በማድረግ የትግራይን ዋና ከተማ መቀሌን መልሰው ተቆጣጥረዋል፣ ይህም እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የነበረውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት አፍርሶታል። የትግራይ አማፂያን ትግላቸውን ለመቀጠል ወደ ገጠር መውጣታቸው ቢነገርም፣ የኤርትራ ወታደሮች ወደ አካባቢው መግባታቸው ግጭቱን ይበልጥ አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል። ይህ ዳግም ያገረሸው ግጭት በኢትዮጵያ ላይ ብቻ ሳይሆን በጎረቤት አገራት መካከል ስጋት በመፍጠር የቀጠናውን የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ውጥረት ውስጥ ከቶታል።
oromo: Humnootni federaalaa Itoophiyaa waraana cimaa booda magaalaa guddoo Tigraay Maqalee to’annoo isaanii jala deebisanii galchaniiru; kunis waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa bara 2022 cabseera. Gareeleen finxaaleyyii naannichaa gara baadiyyaatti baqachuun qabsoo isaanii itti fufuuf waadaa seenus, loltoonni Eertiraa gara naannichaa seenuun isaanii waraanicha yeroo dheeraaf akka itti fufuufi akka hammaatu taasiseera. Dhaabbatee ture jedhamee yaadamuun kun deebi'ee ka'uun isaa biyyoota ollaa keessatti yaaddoo uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, rakkoon kun naannicha guutuu irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu danda'a.

title: Huckabee top aide modified and suppressed US embassy reporting critical of Israel: Report
english: A New York Times investigation reveals that a senior aide to US Ambassador Mike Huckabee has been editing or blocking diplomatic reports critical of Israeli actions in Palestinian territories. Sources claim that David Milstein suppressed information regarding settler violence and settlement expansion, causing significant concern among embassy and Washington officials. Critics argue that these actions distort essential information and potentially contradict the official foreign policy of the US government.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ታይምስ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃክካቢ ከፍተኛ ረዳት በእስራኤል ድርጊቶች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ትችቶችን የያዙ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ሪፖርቶችን ሲያስተካክሉ ወይም ሲያግዱ ቆይተዋል። ዳቪድ ሚልስታይን በተያዙት ግዛቶች ውስጥ ስለሚፈጸሙ የአመጽ ድርጊቶች እና የሰፈራ መስፋፋት የሚገልጹ መረጃዎችን በመደበቅ የዋሽንግተን ባለስልጣናትን ስጋት ላይ ጥለዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ወደ አሜሪካ መንግስት የሚደርሰውን መረጃ በማዛባት የሀገሪቱን የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ የሚቃረን እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Qorannoon 'New York Times' akka agarsiisutti, gargaartuun olaanaan ambaasaaddara Ameerikaa Maayik Haakkabii, gabaasaalee gocha Israa'el irratti qeeqan irratti dhiibbaa gochaa turuu ibseera. Deevid Milstayiin jedhamu gabaasaalee waldhabdee fi babal'ina buufataalee Israa'el irratti xiyyeeffatan gadi dhiisuu ykn jijjiiruu isaatiin hoggantoonni Ameerikaa yaaddoo keessa galaniiru. Gochi kun odeeffannoo sirrii ta'e akka hin geenye dhorkuun, siyaasa alaa biyyattii faallessuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Over 1,800 people missing in Yemen since July, Red Cross says
english: The International Committee of the Red Cross reports that over 1,800 people have gone missing in Yemen following a surge in fighting that began in July. Families are struggling to locate their relatives, and the organization emphasizes that these individuals have a fundamental right to discover what happened to their loved ones. Officials have urged for immediate attention to this crisis to help end the ongoing suffering of these grieving families.
amharic: በየመን ከሐምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ከ1,800 በላይ ሰዎች መጥፋታቸውን የቀይ መስቀል ዓለም አቀፍ ኮሚቴ አስታወቀ። ቤተሰቦች የጠፉባቸውን ወገኖቻቸውን ፍለጋ ከፍተኛ ስቃይ ውስጥ እንደሚገኙ የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉና ምን እንደደረሰባቸው ለማወቅ መብት እንዳላቸው ተቋሙ አስገንዝቧል። የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ስራው በአስቸኳይ ትኩረት ሊሰጠው እንደሚገባም ባለሥልጣናቱ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Godina Yamanitti waraana ji'a Adoolessaa irraa kaasee hammaateen namoonni 1,800 ol ta'an akka bade Komiteen Fannoo Diimaa Addunyaa beeksiseera. Maatiin namoota kanaa firasoota isaanii dhabanii rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru; akkasumas namoonni kun eessa akka jiran beekuun mirga isaanii akka ta'e dhaabbatichi ibseera. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa haala kana xiyyeeffannoon ilaaluun maatii miidhamtootaa kana gargaaruun barbaachisaa akka ta'e yaadachiisaniiru.

title: USS Abraham Lincoln returns to San Diego after deployment during war on Iran
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has arrived back in San Diego following a historic 321-day deployment in the Middle East during the conflict with Iran. Carrying approximately 5,000 personnel, the ship's mission was described by U.S. officials as unprecedented in its duration and scope. Reports have surfaced suggesting that the crew struggled with significant logistical shortages and decreased morale throughout the extended tour.
amharic: የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ ከኢራን ጋር በተደረገው ጦርነት ምክንያት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለ321 ቀናት ያህል ከቆየች በኋላ ወደ ሳንዲያጎ መመለሷ ተገልጿል። ወደ 5,000 የሚጠጉ መርከበኞችን የያዘችው ይህች መርከብ ያከናወነችው ተልዕኮ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ መሆኑን የአሜሪካ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ገልጸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ ረዥሙን የቆይታ ጊዜ ተከትሎ በመርከቧ ላይ የምግብ እና መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶች እጥረት እንዲሁም የሰራተኞች ስሜት መዳከም እንደነበር ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Dooniin xiyyaara feetu USS Abraham Lincoln waraana Iraan waliin taasifameen walqabatee baha giddu galeessaatti guyyoota 321 erga turte booda gara San Diyeegoo deebi'eetti. Hojjettoota 5,000 of keessaa qabu dooniin kun, ergama kanaan dura ta'ee hin beekne raawwachuun isaa qondaaltonni Ameerikaa ibsaniiru. Ta'us, yeroo dheeraa kanatti doonicharra hanqinni nyaataa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo akkasumas dhiphini fi abdii kutannaan hojjettoota gidduutti mul'achaa ture gabaafameera.

title: Watch: At least one plane severely damaged as Houthis claim third Riyadh airport attack
english: Houthi rebels have launched a series of missile strikes targeting multiple Saudi Arabian airports, marking their third attempt to hit Riyadh's main airport. Reports indicate that at least one aircraft sustained significant damage during the incident. Saudi-led coalition forces stated they had intercepted some of the incoming projectiles, but the attacks have continued to pose a threat to regional aviation infrastructure.

title: Oil prices ease after Trump rules out Iran attack before midterms
english: Global oil prices saw a slight decline after President Trump confirmed that the U.S. has no plans to attack Iran before the upcoming midterm elections. Market concerns regarding potential supply issues had caused an earlier price spike, but these eased following reports of diplomatic talks between the two nations. The situation remains sensitive as the U.S. continues to manage high fuel costs ahead of the critical congressional vote.

Kanaan dura sodaan haleellaa fi dhiyeessiin boba'aa addaan cituu danda'a jedhu gatiin boba'aa akka ol ka'u taasisee ture. Haa ta'u malee, mariin diippiloomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamaa jiru kun sodaa gabaa tasgabbeessuun gatiin boba'aa akka gadi bu'u gumaacheera.

title: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
english: Protesters in Spain are occupying central plazas to demonstrate against a severe housing crisis characterized by surging rent prices and a lack of available homes. Demonstrators and government officials argue that investment firms, often labeled as vulture funds, are exacerbating the situation by prioritizing profit through speculation and forced evictions. This growing public frustration has gained momentum following the tragic case of an elderly woman who was evicted by an investment firm, leading to political instability and calls for urgent reform.

title: Police use tear gas and water cannons on student protestors in Paris
english: Students in Paris have been protesting for three weeks to call for improved school resources, more teachers, and better educational conditions. Authorities responded to the ongoing demonstrations by deploying tear gas and water cannons. These aggressive police tactics are now facing public backlash after reports surfaced that multiple teenagers sustained serious injuries during the clashes.

title: Trump gives top US science awards to Elon Musk and other tech executives
english: President Donald Trump awarded prestigious National Medals of Science and Technology to several prominent tech leaders, including Elon Musk, Satya Nadella, and Jensen Huang. During the ceremony, Trump praised these executives for their role in ensuring American technological dominance. This event coincided with the administration's controversial decision to suspend H-1B visa access for some of these same companies due to allegations of system misuse.

title: South Africa protests turn violent amid rage over asylum ruling
english: Violent anti-migrant protests have erupted in Johannesburg and Durban, resulting in dozens of vehicles being set on fire and foreign-owned businesses being targeted. The unrest was sparked by misinformation regarding a recent Constitutional Court ruling that eased certain procedural requirements for asylum seekers. Government officials have clarified that the court decision does not automatically grant legal residency and have condemned the violence.

title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
english: A Russian glide bomb attack on two civilian buses in Kramatorsk, Ukraine, has resulted in the deaths of at least 30 people and left 18 others injured. This tragedy is part of an intensifying wave of Russian strikes across the country, prompting President Zelensky to call for a firm international response. In reaction to these escalating civilian casualties, the UK has pledged additional sanctions against Russia to hinder its military operations.

title: Venezuela's ex-leader Nicolás Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
english: U.S. prosecutors have filed new charges against former Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, accusing them of conspiring to commit torture against political opponents and American citizens. Currently held in a New York detention center following their capture in Caracas, the couple faces allegations of overseeing a brutal system of repression to maintain their grip on power. Their trial is scheduled for June 2027, as authorities continue to build a case that includes accusations of severe physical and psychological abuse.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አቃብያነ ህግ የቀድሞ የቬንዙዌላ መሪ ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ እና ባለቤታቸውን ሲሊያ ፍሎሬስ በፖለቲካ ተቃዋሚዎች እና በአሜሪካ ዜጎች ላይ ስቃይ ፈጽመዋል በሚል አዲስ ክስ መስርተውባቸዋል። ጥንዶቹ በስልጣን ላይ ለመቆየት ጭካኔ የተሞላበት የጭቆና ስርዓት ዘርግተው እንደነበር ክሱ ያስረዳል። በኒውዮርክ እስር ቤት የሚገኙት ጥንዶቹ በሚቀጥለው ሰኔ 2027 ለሚጀምረው የፍርድ ሂደት እየተጠባበቁ ሲሆን፣ ከባድ የአካል እና የአእምሮ ማሰቃየት ፈጽመዋል ተብለው ይከሰሳሉ።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Yunaayitid Isteets dura taa'aa biyya Veenzuweelaa Nikolas Maaduuroo fi haadha warraa isaanii Siliyaa Foloorees irratti, mormitoota siyaasaa fi lammiilee Ameerikaa irratti dararaa raawwataniiru jedhee himannaa haaraa baneera. Himannaan kun kan agarsiisu, hoggantoonni kun aangoo isaanii eeggachuuf jecha sirna cunqursaa fi dararaa cimaa diriirsuu isaanii dha. Maaduuroo fi haadha warraa isaanii yeroo ammaa buufata mana hidhaa Niwuu Yoorkii keessatti argamuun, qormaanni isaanii baatii Waxabajjii bara 2027 akka jalqabu beekameera.

title: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
english: Severe flooding caused by heavy rainfall has forced emergency rescues in central Chile, particularly in the city of Talagante where the Mapocho river overflowed. The region is experiencing its wettest October in decades due to the impact of the El Niño weather phenomenon. Authorities have confirmed one death in the area as they brace for continued stormy conditions throughout the spring.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ቺሊ በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የተከሰተው ጎርፍ ነዋሪዎችን አደጋ ላይ የጣለ ሲሆን፣ ማፖቾ የተባለው ወንዝ በመሙላቱ ብዙዎች በሄሊኮፕተር ታድገዋል። በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ሳቢያ ክልሉ ላለፉት 76 ዓመታት ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የጥቅምት ወር ዝናብ እያስተናገደ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት በአንድ አካባቢ የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ማለፉን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ በቀጣይም ተጨማሪ አውሎ ንፋስ እና ዝናብ ሊኖር እንደሚችል ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan kibbaa fi jabaan giddu galeessa Chile keessatti roobee laga Mapocho guuchisuun isaa jiraattoota hedduu manneen isaanii keessatti akka cufaman taasiseera. Rakkoo uumame kanaan wal qabatee poolisiin heelikoptera fayyadamuun namoota hedduu lubbuun baraareera. Sababa mudannoo 'El Niño' jedhamuun naannichi rooba ganna 76 keessatti hin argamin erga argatee booda, qaamoleen mootummaa namni tokko lubbuun darbuusaa mirkaneessanii, gara fuulduraattis roobni fi bubbeen itti fufuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
english: The Italian parliament has passed a significant electoral reform championed by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, which transitions the country to a proportional voting system that awards extra parliamentary seats to coalitions reaching 42% of the vote. While Meloni claims these changes will provide government stability, opposition leaders have strongly criticized the move as an undemocratic attempt to manipulate election outcomes. The Prime Minister secured this victory by framing the vote as a crucial test of her authority, threatening to step down if the legislation failed.
amharic: የጣሊያን ፓርላማ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጆርጂያ ሜሎኒ የሚደገፈውን አዲስ የምርጫ ህግ ማሻሻያ አጽድቋል። ይህ አዲስ ህግ በምርጫ 42 በመቶ ድምጽ ለሚያገኙ ጥምረቶች ተጨማሪ የፓርላማ መቀመጫዎችን በመስጠት አገሪቱን ወደ ተመጣጣኝ የምርጫ ስርዓት ያሸጋግራል። ሜሎኒ ማሻሻያው የመንግስትን መረጋጋት ለማምጣት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች ግን ይህ እርምጃ ስልጣን ለመቆየት የታቀደ ህገ-ወጥ ሙከራ ነው በማለት ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሯ ህጉ ካልጸደቀ ስልጣናቸውን እንደሚለቁ በማስፈራራት ድምጹን የራሳቸው የፖለቲካ ፈተና አድርገውት ነበር።
oromo: Parlamaan Xaaliyaanii jijjiirama sirna filannoo kan ministira muummee Giorgia Meloniin deeggarame raggaasiseera. Seerri haaraan kun biyyattii gara sirna filannoo tarreeffamaatti kan jijjiiru yoo ta'u, kutaalee filannoo keessatti yoo xiqqaate harka 42 argatanif teessoo dabalataa kennuuf karoorfameera. Meloni jijjiirama kanaan tasgabbii mootummaa akka mirkaneessan kan dubbatan ta'us, mormitoonni garuu adeemsi kun aangoo of harkatti qabachuuf kan karoorfamee fi dimokiraasii kan tuqu akka ta'e himuun mormaniiru. Ministirri muummee kun seerri kun yoo raggaasuu baate aangoorraa akka gad-bu'an dhaadachuun yaada kana akka qormaata aangoo isaanii irratti fudhataniiru.

title: Man City must ‘stick together’ after Premier League charges, says Haaland
english: Manchester City striker Erling Haaland is urging his teammates to remain united and positive following an independent commission's guilty verdict regarding over 100 financial rule breaches. The club maintains its innocence and has officially appealed the decision, which could result in severe penalties such as points deductions or even relegation. Despite the off-field pressure and an expected hostile environment for their upcoming match against Liverpool, Haaland insists the squad must stay focused on winning games.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ሲቲ አጥቂ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ክለቡ ከ100 በላይ የፋይናንስ ደንቦችን በመተላለፉ ጥፋተኛ መባሉን ተከትሎ፣ የቡድን አባላት አንድነታቸውን ጠብቀው በአዎንታዊ መልኩ እንዲቀጥሉ አሳስቧል። ማንቸስተር ሲቲ የቀረበበትን ክስ በመቃወም ይግባኝ የጠየቀ ሲሆን፣ ውሳኔው እንደጸና ቢቀር ክለቡ ከሊግ የመውረድ ወይም የነጥብ ቅነሳ ሊገጥመው ይችላል። ከሜዳ ውጪ ያለው ይህ ውጥረት እና ከሊቨርፑል ጋር የሚጠበቀው ከባድ ጨዋታ ቢኖርም፣ ሃላንድ ቡድኑ በትኩረት ጨዋታዎችን ማሸነፍ ላይ እንዲያተኩር አሳስቧል።
oromo: Qubeessaan garee Manchester City Erling Haaland, gareen isaa seera faayinaansii 100 ol cabseera jedhamee murteen irratti dabarsuu isaatiin walitti dhufee akka tokko ta'u gaafate. Manchester City himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta'u, murtee kana mormuudhaan iyyata dhiyeeffateera; yoo murteen kun jijjiiramee hin argamne garuu, gareen kun liigii gad-aanaatti bu'uu ykn qabxii hir'ifachuu danda'a. Dhiibbaa alaa jiruufi morkii cimaa tapha Liverpool irratti eegamuuf osoo hin jilbeenfatin, Haaland gareen isaa xiyyeeffannoo isaanii tapha injifachuu irratti akka godhatan dhaameera.

title: UK ex-prince Andrew search warrants quashed after police accept legal error
english: A UK court has canceled search warrants used to investigate Prince Andrew because the police admitted they obtained them through a legal error. Although the warrants are now void, officials confirmed that the broader investigation into the former royal regarding his ties to Jeffrey Epstein remains active. Authorities are currently fighting a legal battle to determine if they can legally keep the evidence seized during those searches.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ፍርድ ቤት ልዑል አንድሪው ላይ የወጡ የፍተሻ ማዘዣዎች በህግ ስህተት የተገኙ በመሆናቸው እንዲሰረዙ ወስኗል። ፖሊስ ስህተቱን ቢቀበልም፣ ከጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ጋር ባላቸው ግንኙነት ላይ የተጀመረው ምርመራ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ አስታውቋል። በወቅቱ የተያዙ ማስረጃዎች በህጋዊ መንገድ እንዲቆዩ ለማድረግ ባለስልጣናት የፍርድ ቤት ክርክር እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii UK kan mootummaa Biritaaniyaa, ajajni sakatta'iinsa mana leencicha Andrew irratti ba'ee ture dogoggora seeraatiin waan argameef akka haqamu murteesseera. Poolisiin dogoggoricha kan fudhate yoo ta'u, qorannoon hariiroo isaa fi Jefri Epistayn gidduu jiru akka itti fufu mirkaneesseera. Amma immoo, ragaawwan sakatta'iinsa sanaan qabaman seeraan qabachuu akka danda'an dhaabbileen nageenyaa mana murtii irratti falmaa jiru.

title: Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
english: New video footage suggests that the Malian military has regained control of the city of Kidal from Tuareg separatist rebels. This development represents a significant strategic and symbolic victory for the country's military government. The city had been under the control of the separatist group for the past six months.
amharic: በቅርቡ የተለቀቀው ምስል እንደሚጠቁመው የካቲት ከተማን ከተገንጣይ የቱዋሬግ ታጣቂዎች እጅ ማስመለስ መቻሉን የካቲት ሰራዊት አረጋግጧል። ይህም ለሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ መንግስት ትልቅ ስልታዊ እና ምሳሌያዊ ድል ነው። ከተማዋ ላለፉት ስድስት ወራት በተገንጣዮቹ ቁጥጥር ስር ትገኝ ነበር።
oromo: Suurri fi viidiyoon dhiheenya kana bahe akka agarsiisutti, waraanni Maali magaalaa Kidaal harka finxaaleyyii tuwareg irraa deebisee to’annoo isaa jala galcheera. Injifannoon kun mootummaa waraanaa biyyattii tiif injifannoo guddaa fi mallattoo cimaa dha. Magaalattiin ji’oota ja’an darbanif harka garee finxaaleyyii kanaa jala turte.

title: Venezuela’s Nicolas Maduro and his wife charged over torture allegations
english: Former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, have been charged in a New York federal court with conspiracy to commit torture. Prosecutors allege the couple oversaw a long-term campaign involving the abuse of political rivals and American citizens to maintain their hold on power. These new accusations build upon existing drug trafficking charges, with evidence suggesting Maduro personally directed or monitored the use of violent interrogation methods.
amharic: የቬኔዝዌላው የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ እና ባለቤታቸው ሲሊያ ፍሎሬስ በኒውዮርክ የፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት ስቃይ የመፈጸም ሴራ እንደገጠማቸው ተከሰሱ። ዓቃቤ ህጎች እንደሚሉት ጥንዶቹ ስልጣናቸውን ለማስጠበቅ ሲሉ ተቃዋሚዎችን እና የአሜሪካ ዜጎችን በዘዴ ሲያሰቃዩ ቆይተዋል። እነዚህ አዳዲስ ክሶች ከዚህ ቀደም ከቀረቡባቸው የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ክሶች በተጨማሪ የቀረቡ ሲሆን፣ ማዱሮ በተለያዩ ጊዜያት የጭካኔ ድርጊቶችን በቀጥታ ሲያዙ እንደነበር መረጃዎች ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii biyya Veenezuweelaa Niikolaas Maaduuroofi haati warraa isaanii Siiliyaa Filoorees, mana murtii federaalaa Niiwyoorkiitti yakka gidiraa ykn hiraarsuu raawwachuun himatamani. Abbaan alangaa akka himatutti, namoonni kunneen aangoosaanii itti fufsiisuuf jecha mormitoota siyaasaafi lammiilee Ameerikaa irratti gidirsuu fi dararaa raawwachaa turani. Himannaan haaraan kun himannaa gurgurtaa qorichoota sammuu hadoochan dura isaan irratti dhiyaatee ture irratti kan dabalame yoo ta'u, Maaduuroon ofii isaanii dararaa raawwachuun akka ajajaa turan himameera.

title: London voters go to polls for Holborn and St Pancras by-election
english: Voters in London’s Holborn and St Pancras district are casting ballots in a parliamentary by-election following the resignation of former Prime Minister Keir Starmer. The contest is primarily seen as a challenge for Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s Labour Party, which is facing strong competition from the Green Party. This election serves as an important test for Labour to regain support from left-wing voters after losing ground due to conflicts in Gaza.
amharic: የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኬይር ስታርመር ሥልጣን መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የለንደን ሆልቦርን እና ሴንት ፓንክራስ ነዋሪዎች የምርጫ ክልላቸውን ተወካይ ለመምረጥ ድምፅ እየሰጡ ነው። ይህ ምርጫ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የሚመሩት የሌበር ፓርቲ፣ ከአረንጓዴው ፓርቲ ጋር የሚያደርገው ከፍተኛ ፉክክር የሚታይበት ነው። በጋዛ ግጭት ምክንያት ተፅዕኖ የደረሰበት የሌበር ፓርቲ፣ ይህንን ምርጫ የቀድሞ ድጋፉን እንደገና ለማደስ እንደ ወሳኝ የፈተና ምዕራፍ እየተመለከተው ነው።
oromo: jiraattonni London, naannoo Holborn fi St Pancras, booda gadi lakkisuu ministira muummee durii Keir Starmer bakka bu'aa isaanii filachuuf sagalee kennuutti jiru. Filannoon kun mootummaa ministira muummee Andy Burnham fi paartii Labour irratti dhiibbaa guddaa kan uume yoo ta'u, paartii Green wajjin morkii cimaa keessa jiru. Paartiin Labour waraana Gaza sababeeffachuun deeggarsa isaa hir'ate deeffachuuf, filannoon kun yaalii isaanii isa guddaa dha.

title: US and Lebanon protecting wanted Syrian general, BBC finds
english: A BBC investigation has revealed that the US and Lebanon are shielding Bassam al-Hassan, a former Syrian general accused of war crimes. Authorities are allowing him to live safely in Lebanon in exchange for intelligence regarding the 2012 abduction of American journalist Austin Tice. While the Syrian government is seeking his extradition to face justice, US officials have reportedly prevented his return to prioritize the investigation into Tice's disappearance.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው አሜሪካ እና ሊባኖስ በጦር ወንጀል የተከሰሱትን የቀድሞ የሶሪያ ጄኔራል ባሳም አል-ሀሰንን እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ። ባለሥልጣናቱ ለጄኔራሉ በሊባኖስ የመኖር ዕድል የፈቀዱት እ.ኤ.አ በ2012 ታፍኖ ስለተወሰደው አሜሪካዊ ጋዜጠኛ ኦስቲን ታይስ መረጃ እንዲሰጥ ነው። የሶሪያ መንግስት ለፍርድ እንዲቀርብ ቢጠይቅም፣ አሜሪካ የጋዜጠኛውን ጉዳይ ለማጣራት ሲባል ጄኔራሉ በሊባኖስ እንዲቆይ እያደረገች መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC akka agarsiisutti, Ameerikaan fi Libaanoos ajajaa waraanaa Sooriyaa kanaan dura ture, Bassaam al-Hassan, yakka waraanaatiin himatame akka eegan ibsameera. Aangeyyoonni kun, hoggansa kanaaf Libaanoos keessa jiraachuuf heeyyama kennan kanneen, odeeffannoo gaazexeessaa Ameerikaa Ostin Taayis waggaa 2012 keessa butame irratti akka kennuufi. Mootummaan Sooriyaa namni kun seeratti akka dhiyaatu gaafatus, Ameerikaan dhimma Taayis qulqulleeffachuuf jecha ajajaan kun Libaanoos keessa akka turu gochaa jirti.

title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
english: Most British diplomats are leaving the consulate in East Jerusalem following an Israeli order to scale down operations as retaliation for UK sanctions on settlements. While Israel claims the consulate is closing, the UK government maintains that the building will remain open as a mission to provide essential services to Palestinians. A small team of seven staff members will continue working at the site under restricted conditions.
amharic: እስራኤል በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በሰፈራዎች ላይ በጣለችው ማዕቀብ ምላሽ የብሪታንያ ቆንስላን ስራ እንዲቀንስ በማዘዟ፣ አብዛኛዎቹ የብሪታንያ ዲፕሎማቶች ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌምን ለቀው እየወጡ ነው። እስራኤል ቆንስላው እየተዘጋ እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ግን ህንጻው ለፍልስጤም ህዝብ ወሳኝ አገልግሎቶችን ለመስጠት ክፍት ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። ሰባት ዲፕሎማቶች ብቻ በተወሰነ የስራ ወሰን በቦታው ሆነው መስራታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ።
oromo: Israa'el mootummaan UK buufataalee gara fuulduraatti ijaaramu irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuushee hordofee, quunnamtii dippilomasii isaanii akka xiqqeessan ajajuun, dippilomatonni UK hedduun Yerusaalem bahaa gadi dhiisanii bahuuf dirqamaniiru. Israa'el buufatichi cufameera jettee labsuus, mootummaan UK garuu iddoon kun hojii isaa itti fufanii tajaajila barbaachisaa ta'e akka kennu ibseera. Hojjettoonni torba qofa ta'an haala daangeeffameen iddoo sana keessa ta'anii hojii isaanii itti fufu.

title: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
english: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, is now reportedly walking in the hospital after surviving a rare, botched execution attempt involving two lethal injections. While she remains mentally disoriented from the drugs used, her legal team notes her physical recovery is progressing. A court has ordered authorities to preserve all evidence from the incident, which may lead to future legal action against the state.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ቴነሲ ግዛት የሞት ፍርድ የተፈረደባት ክሪስታ ፓይክ፣ በሁለት መርፌዎች የታገዘ የሞት ፍርድ ሙከራ ካመለጠች በኋላ በአሁኑ ወቅት ሆስፒታል ውስጥ እንደምትራመድ ጠበቆቿ ገልጸዋል። በሰውነቷ ውስጥ በተወጉት መድኃኒቶች ምክንያት አእምሮዋ አሁንም ግራ መጋባት ውስጥ ቢሆንም፣ የአካል ሁኔታዋ ግን እየተሻሻለ መምጣቱ ታውቋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የዚህን ያልተሳካ የሞት ፍርድ ሂደት ማስረጃዎች በሙሉ እንዲጠበቁ ትእዛዝ ሰጥቷል፣ ይህም ለወደፊት በግዛቲቱ ላይ ክስ ለመመስረት ሊያገለግል ይችላል።
oromo: Murtee du'aa kan itti murteeffamee turte Christa Pike, yaaliin ajjeechaa ishee irratti godhame erga milka'uu baatee booda ammayyuu hospitaala keessatti deemuufi ka'uu akka dandeessu abbootii seeraa isheetu ibse. Qorichoota ishee irratti itti fayyadaman irraa kan ka'e sammuun ishee ammayyuu wal-qabachuu baatus, fayyummaan ishee qaamaa garuu fooyya'aa jira. Mana maree seeraa kanatti aansuun, ragaaleen yaalii ajjeechaa kanaa akka eegamuuf ajajni kennamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis gara fuulduraatti mootummaa irratti himannaa banuuf gargaaruu danda'a.

title: Texas carries out first US execution since Christa Pike's botched lethal injections
english: Texas has carried out the execution of 46-year-old Jamaal Howard following a failed lethal injection attempt on another inmate in a different state last week. Although Howard's legal team requested a stay of execution, citing concerns that the drug supply was potentially degraded and unsafe, the courts and the governor denied these appeals. Howard, who was convicted of a 2000 murder during a robbery, apologized to the victim's family before his death was pronounced on Wednesday evening.

Gareen abukaattota Haawwaard qorichi fayyadamame sun irra deddeebi’ee kan hin hojjenneefi nageenya kan hin qabne ta’uu isaa himuun adabbiin kun akka harkifatu gaafatanis, mana murtii fi gubarnariin isaa garuu didaniiru. Namni bara 2000 yakka saamichaa fi ajjeechaatiin balleessaa jedhamee murteeffame kun, guyyaa Roobii galgala erga ajjeefamee booda maatii midhamtootaaf dhiifama gaafateera.

title: Jon Rahm to quit LIV Golf tour over ‘unacceptable’ terms
english: Renowned golfer Jon Rahm has officially announced his departure from the LIV Golf circuit. His legal representative stated that the terms proposed for the tour's upcoming restructured phase, known as LIV 2.0, are not acceptable to the athlete. This decision comes as the organization undergoes bankruptcy proceedings and faces requests from multiple other star players to terminate their existing contracts due to unpaid obligations.
amharic: ታዋቂው የጎልፍ ተጫዋች ጆን ራም ከሊቭ ጎልፍ ጉብኝት መልቀቁን በይፋ አስታውቋል። የህግ አማካሪው እንደገለፁት አትሌቱ ለቀጣዩ የውድድር ዘመን ወይም 'ሊቭ 2.0' የቀረቡለትን የአሰራር ሁኔታዎች እንደማይቀበላቸው ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተሰማው ድርጅቱ በኪሳራ ሂደት ውስጥ ባለበት እና ሌሎች በርካታ ታዋቂ ተጫዋቾች ክፍያ ስላልተፈጸመላቸው ውላቸውን ለማቋረጥ በፍርድ ቤት በኩል ጥያቄ ባቀረቡበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Taphatooni goolfii beekamaan Jon Raam gahiinsa isaa kan 'LIV Golf' irraa ta'e ifatti beeksiseera. Abukaatoon isaa akka ibsetti, haalli haaraan 'LIV 2.0' jedhamuun qophaa'e taphatichaaf fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu mirkaneesseera. Murtoon kun kan dhufu, dhaabbatichi rakkoo baankii keessa jiruufi taphatoonni guguddoon biroon kaffaltii dhabuu isaaniitiin walqabatee waliigaltee isaanii addaan kutuuf mana murtiitti iyyata dhiyeeffataa jiran keessattidha.

title: ‘Nature can recover’: Inside the race to rescue world’s crisis-hit wildlife
english: Despite a alarming 73 percent decline in global wildlife populations over the last five decades, the recovery of mountain gorillas serves as a beacon of hope. By combining long-term protection, scientific research, and active involvement from local communities, conservationists have successfully boosted gorilla numbers from near extinction. This success demonstrates that consistent, community-based environmental efforts can effectively reverse biodiversity loss and help nature thrive.

title: How Gaza war sped up India’s shift towards Israel under Modi
english: Under Prime Minister Narendra Modi, India has significantly strengthened its ties with Israel despite the ongoing conflict in Gaza. While many Western nations have distanced themselves from the Israeli government, India recently hosted far-right Israeli ministers and expanded trade agreements. This represents a major shift from India's long-standing historical support for the Palestinian cause.
amharic: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ ስልጣን ከያዙ ወዲህ፣ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ችላ በማለት ህንድ ከእስራኤል ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ አጠናክራለች። ብዙ የምዕራባውያን ሀገራት ከእስራኤል መንግስት እየራቁ ባለበት በአሁኑ ወቅት፣ ህንድ የእስራኤልን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናትን በክብር በመቀበል የንግድ ስምምነቶችን ፈጽማለች። ይህ አካሄድ ህንድ ለረጅም ዓመታት ለፍልስጤም ትሰጠው የነበረውን ታሪካዊ ድጋፍ ሙሉ በሙሉ የቀየረ ይመስላል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Naarendraa Moodii erga aangoo qabatanii as, waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru hubannoo keessa galchuudhaan hariiroo Hindii fi Israa'el gidduu jiru daran cimsuun isaanii ibsameera. Biyyoonni Dhihaa hedduun mootummaa Israa'el irraa fagaachaa jiranis, Hindii garuu ministiroota Israa'el kanneen mormii guddaa keessa jiran simachuudhaan waliigaltee daldalaa babal'ifatteetti.
