title: Christa Pike almost taken off life support before she woke up
english: Death row prisoner Christa Pike regained consciousness just moments before doctors were prepared to disconnect her life support systems. Her legal representative reported that her first reaction upon waking was confusion regarding her identity and whereabouts. A judge has now ordered authorities to protect all evidence related to this failed execution process.
amharic: በሞት ቅጣት ላይ የምትገኘው ክሪስታ ፓይክ የህይወት ድጋፍ ሰጪ መሳሪያዎቿ ከመዘጋታቸው ጥቂት ደቂቃዎች በፊት ንቃተ ህሊናዋን መልሳ አግኝታለች። ጠበቃዋ እንደገለጹት፣ ከእንቅልፏ ስትነቃ የመጀመሪያዋ ጥያቄ የት እንዳለች እና ማን እንደሆነች መጠየቋን ነው። ዳኛው ከዚህ ያልተሳካ የሞት ቅጣት ሂደት ጋር የተያያዙ ማስረጃዎች እንዳይጠፉ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Adaba du’aatti kan murteeffamte Kristaa Paayik, yeroo sirni deeggarsa lubbuu ishee addaan cituuf turetti daqiiqaa muraasa dura ofitti deebiteetti. Abukaatoon ishee akka jedhanitti, yeroo dammaqxu gaaffiin ishee jalqabaa eessa akka jirtuufi eenyu akka taate gaafachuu ture. Amma abbaan seeraa ragaan adeemsa ajjeechaa kanaa walqabatu hundi akka hin badne ajaja kenneera.

title: Video: Signs removed from British consulate in occupied East Jerusalem
english: The British consulate located in occupied East Jerusalem has removed its exterior signage ahead of a scheduled closure. The UK government announced that the facility will be repurposed to serve as a British diplomatic mission. This change follows a formal decision by UK officials regarding the building's future status.
amharic: በተያዘው ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘው የብሪታንያ ቆንስላ ከመዘጋቱ በፊት የውጪ ምልክቶቹን አስወግዷል። የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግስት ህንጻው ወደፊት እንደ ብሪታንያ ዲፕሎማቲክ ተልዕኮ ሆኖ እንደሚያገለግል አስታውቋል። ይህ ለውጥ የተደረገው የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት በህንጻው የወደፊት ሁኔታ ላይ በወሰኑት ውሳኔ መሰረት ነው።
oromo: Qonsilaan Biriiteen magaalaa Yerusaalem Bahaa qabamtee jirtu keessatti argamu, akkuma cufamuun isaa ga'ee jiruun mallattoo alaa isaa kaaseera. Mootummaan Biriiteen akka ibsetti, iddoon kun gara fuulduraatti ergama diippilomaasii Biriiteen ta'ee akka tajaajilu murtaa'eera. Jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe erga aangessonni Biriiteen haala iddoo sanaa irratti murtoo kennanii booda.

title: After Colombia's exit, what is left of the Hague Group?
english: Colombia has officially withdrawn from the Hague Group, a coalition of nations formed in 2025 to pursue legal and diplomatic accountability for Israel's actions in Gaza. This move, driven by the country's new right-wing administration, follows similar departures by Bolivia and Honduras, leaving South Africa as the sole leader of the bloc. The group serves as a collaborative platform for states to enforce international law, though it now faces significant instability due to shifting political tides in Latin America.
amharic: ኮሎምቢያ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 እስራኤል በጋዛ ለምትፈጽመው ድርጊት ተጠያቂነትን ለማምጣት ከተመሰረተው 'ዘ ሄግ ግሩፕ' ከተባለው ህብረት በይፋ ወጥታለች። በአዲሱ የቀኝ ዘመም አስተዳደር የተወሰነው ይህ ውሳኔ ከቦሊቪያ እና ከሆንዱራስ ተመሳሳይ የመውጣት እርምጃዎች በኋላ የተከተለ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ደቡብ አፍሪካን የቡድኑ ብቸኛ መሪ አድርጓታል። ቡድኑ ሀገራት አለም አቀፍ ህግን እንዲያስከብሩ የሚያግዝ መድረክ ቢሆንም፣ በላቲን አሜሪካ እየታየ ባለው የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Kolombiyaan mootummaa mirga-waarii haaraa ishee jalatti, dhaabbata 'The Hague Group' jedhamu kan bara 2025 Israa'el tarkaanfii Gaazaatti fudhattuuf seeratti dhiyeessuuf hundaa'e irraa gadi baateetti. Biyyi kun biyyoota akka Boliviyaa fi Honduras duraan gadi ba'an hordofuun, South Afrikaa qofa akka durfutti haftee jirti. Dhaabbatichi biyyoonni seera idil-addunyaa akka kabajachiisan gargaaruuf kan hundaa'e ta'us, jijjiirama siyaasaa Laatin Ameerikaa keessatti mul'achaa jiruun rakkoo guddaa keessa galeera.

title: UK says Israel has no legal authority to close Jerusalem consulate
english: The British government has rejected Israel's attempt to shut down its long-standing consulate in East Jerusalem, stating that Israel lacks the legal authority to do so. In response to Israeli restrictions, the UK will rebrand the office as a mission and continue operations while negotiating the site's future. Britain has also confirmed it will not retaliate against Israeli diplomatic staff while these discussions remain ongoing.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት እስራኤል በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን የቆየ ቆንስላዋን ለመዝጋት የወሰደችውን እርምጃ ህጋዊ መሰረት የለውም በማለት ውድቅ አድርጓል። ብሪታንያ ቆንስላውን እንደ አዲስ 'የዩኬ ተልዕኮ' ብላ በመሰየም ስራዋን እንደምትቀጥል እና ስለወደፊቱ ሁኔታም ከእስራኤል ጋር ድርድር እንደምትጀምር አስታውቃለች። እስራኤል ሰራተኞችን ለመገደብ የወሰደችው እርምጃ ቢኖርም፣ ብሪታንያ በድርድሩ ወቅት ምንም አይነት የበቀል እርምጃ እንደማትወስድ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritish, Israa'el quunxulaa isaanii kan Baha Yerusaalem jiru cufuuf yaalii goote akka hin fudhanne ibseera; kunis Israa'el cufuuf aangoo seeraa akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru. Biritish dhaabbaticha 'ergama YUK' (UK mission) jechuun maqaa jijjiiruun hojiisaa itti fufuufafi fuuldurasaa irratti mari'achuuf murteessiteetti. Israa'el hojjattoota lakkoofsaan daangessuus, Biritish mariin kun amansiisaa ta'ee jiruutti tarkaanfii deebii kennuu akka hin barbaadne mirkaneessiteetti.

title: US approves over $2bn in weapons sales to Egypt, Kuwait and UAE
english: The United States government has authorized over $2 billion in arms sales to Egypt, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates. Egypt is acquiring anti-tank missiles, while Kuwait is purchasing maintenance and parts for its existing air defense systems. The United Arab Emirates made the largest purchase, securing over 10,000 laser-guided precision weapon kits.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከ2 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚገመት የጦር መሳሪያ ለግብፅ፣ ለኩዌት እና ለተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬቶች ለመሸጥ አጽድቋል። ግብፅ ፀረ-ታንክ ሚሳኤሎችን ስትገዛ፣ ኩዌት የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓቷን ለመጠገን የሚያስፈልጉ መለዋወጫዎችን ታገኛለች። የተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬቶች ደግሞ ከሁሉም በላይ ውድ የሆነውን ከ10,000 በላይ የሌዘር መመሪያ ያላቸው የጦር መሳሪያዎች ግዢ ፈጽማለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoota Gibxii, Kuweyt fi Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomaniif meeshaalee waraanaa gatiin isaanii dolaara biiliyoona 2 ol ta'u gurguruuf hayyameera. Gibxiin misaa'ela taankii cabsu, Kuweyt ammoo sirna ittisa qilleensa ishee fooyyessuuf gargaarsa fi meeshaalee barbaachisaa bitachaa jirti. Emireetotni Arabaa Gamtoomaniis, meeshaalee waraanaa xiyyaafannoo sirrii qaban kanneen akka 'APKWS-II' 10,000 ol ta'an bituudhaan gurgurtaa kana keessatti hirmaatan.

title: UK says consulate in Jerusalem to remain open as its mission
english: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced that the UK consulate in East Jerusalem will stay open rather than shutting down. Moving forward, the office will be rebranded as a UK Mission. It will continue to function independently to provide services to the Palestinian people.
amharic: የብሪታንያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘው የብሪታንያ ቆንስላ እንደማይዘጋ አስታውቀዋል። ይልቁንም ይህ ተቋም ከዚህ በኋላ የዩኬ ሚሽን በሚል መጠሪያ እንደሚታወቅ ተገልጿል። ቢሮው በነፃነት መስራቱን በመቀጠል ለፍልስጤም ህዝብ አገልግሎት መስጠቱን ይቀጥላል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Biriiteen Ed Miilibaand akka ibsetti, konsilaan Biriiteen baha Yerusaalem keessatti argamu hin cufamu. Bakka konsilaatti, waajjirichi maqaa 'UK Mission' jedhamuun kan itti fufu ta'uun beekameera. Waajjirichi bilisa ta'ee hojiisaa kan itti fufuufi ummata Filisxeemiif tajaajila kennuusaas kan itti fufu ta'a.

title: I left Gaza, but my body is trapped in the horrors of war
english: A Palestinian survivor who fled Gaza in early 2024 struggles with profound physical and psychological trauma. Ordinary triggers like the call to prayer or the sound of airplanes cause intense panic attacks because they evoke memories of life-threatening bombings. Additionally, the author lives with lasting physical injuries and a debilitating fear of doors resulting from violent incidents experienced while being displaced.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 መጀመሪያ ላይ ጋዛን ለቆ የወጣ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ፣ ከአካላዊ እና ከስነ-ልቦና ጉዳቶች ጋር እየታገለ ይገኛል። እንደ የጸሎት ጥሪ ወይም የአውሮፕላን ድምፅ ያሉ ተራ ነገሮች፣ በአሰቃቂ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ጊዜ የነበሩትን አስፈሪ ትዝታዎች በመቀስቀስ ከፍተኛ የፍርሃት ስሜት ይፈጥሩበታል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም፣ ደራሲው በተፈናቀሉበት ወቅት በደረሰባቸው አደጋ ምክንያት ዘላቂ አካላዊ ጉዳት እና የበሮች ከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ስሜት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namni Falasxiin kan bara 2024 jalqaba irratti Gaazaadhaa baqate kun, miidhaa qaamaa fi sammuu cimaa keessa jira. Sagaleen waamicha salaataa ykn sagaleen xiyyaaraa yeroo ammaa yaadannoo dhukaasaa fi weeraraa hamaa waan isa yaadachiisuuf, rifannaa cimaa keessa gala. Kana malees, yeroo buqqa’insaa isarratti mudate irraa kan ka’e, miidhaan qaamaa inni qabu akkasumas sodaa balbala irraa qabu jireenya isaa guyyuu irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: Why is Guantanamo prison still open?
english: The Guantanamo Bay detention facility was established following the US invasion of Afghanistan and once housed hundreds of individuals. Although the conflict has officially ended, the facility continues to operate decades later. This report explores the ongoing reasons behind the prison's continued existence despite the end of the war.
amharic: የጓንታናሞ ቤይ እስር ቤት በአፍጋኒስታን የአሜሪካ ወረራ በኋላ የተቋቋመ ሲሆን በአንድ ወቅት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ እስረኞችን ይዞ ነበር። ጦርነቱ በይፋ ቢጠናቀቅም እስር ቤቱ ከሃያ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላም አሁንም ድረስ አገልግሎት እየሰጠ ይገኛል። ይህ ዘገባ ጦርነቱ ካበቃ በኋላም እስር ቤቱ ለምን እንደማይዘጋ ምክንያቶቹን ይዳስሳል።
oromo: Buufanni hidhattoota Guantanamo Bay erga Ameerikaan Afghaanistaan weerarte booda kan hundaa'e yoo ta'u, yeroo tokko namoota dhibbaan lakkaa'aman qabatee ture. Waraanni sun erga xumuramee waggoonni 25 darbanis, mana hidhaa kana cufuu hin dandeenye. Gabaasni kun waraanni erga dhaabbatee booda maaliif ammas akka banamee jiratu ibsuuf yaala.

title: Democrats sue US President Trump over taxpayer-funded ad campaign
english: The Democratic National Committee and the watchdog group Common Cause have filed lawsuits against President Trump, alleging that he improperly used $20 million in taxpayer funds for political campaign advertisements. These groups argue that the President redirected money intended for border security commemorative activities to support Republican interests before the midterm elections, which violates federal laws against using public funds for propaganda. The lawsuits seek to stop the ad campaign immediately and recover the misspent government money.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ብሔራዊ ኮሚቴ እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድን ኮመን ኮዝ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የህዝብ ግብርን ለፖለቲካ ማስታወቂያዎች አላግባብ ተጠቅመዋል በማለት ክስ መሥርተዋል። እነዚህ ተቋማት ፕሬዝዳንቱ ለድንበር ደህንነት መታሰቢያነት የተመደበውን 20 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የገንዘብ ድጋፍ፣ ከመካከለኛ ምርጫው በፊት ለሪፐብሊካኖች ድጋፍ እንዲውል ማድረጋቸውን ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ድርጊት የህዝብ ገንዘብን ለፖለቲካ ፕሮፓጋንዳ መጠቀምን የሚከለክለውን ህግ የሚጥስ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ የተጀመረው የማስታወቂያ ዘመቻ እንዲቆም እና የወጣው ገንዘብ እንዲመለስ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Komiteen Biyyaalessaa Diimokraatawaa fi gareen hordoffii Common Cause jedhamu, Pirezidaant Tiraamp maallaqa gibira kaffaltuu miliyoona 20 ta'u adeemsa siyaasaa isaanii guddifachuuf seeraan alatti fayyadaman jechuun himannaa bananiiru. Gareen kunneen, Pirezidaantichi maallaqa nageenya daangaa kabachiisuuf qophaa'e gara duula filannoo Repabilikanootti dabarsuun isaanii seera federaalaa kan cabsu ta'uu ibsu. Himannaan kun duulli beeksisaa kun yeruma sana akka dhaabbatuu fi maallaqni akka tasaa bahame kunis akka deebi'u gaafata.

title: Death of 87-year old sparks furious Spain housing protests
english: Massive protests have erupted in Spain following the death of an 87-year-old woman who was recently evicted from her home. Demonstrators gathered outside Parliament to demand better housing affordability and a stop to rising rent costs. The incident has intensified public frustration regarding the housing crisis just before the upcoming snap elections.
amharic: ከቤቷ በተፈናቀለች በ87 ዓመቷ አዛውንት ሞት ሳቢያ በስፔን ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች የቤት ኪራይ መናርን እና ተመጣጣኝ የመኖሪያ ቤት እጦትን በመቃወም በፓርላማው ፊት ለፊት ተሰብስበዋል። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ዋዜማ በሀገሪቱ ያለውን የቤት አቅርቦት ችግር ተከትሎ የህዝቡን ቁጣ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Ispeen keessatti dubartii umuriin ishee waggaa 87 ta’e mana isheerraa erga buqqifamtee booda du’uun ishee mormii guddaa kaasuu isaa gabaafameera. Namoonni hedduun mana maree biyyattii fuulduratti walga’uun, gatii kiree mana jireenyaa kan ol ka’e tasgabbeessuu fi mana jireenyaa gatii madaalawaa ta’e akka dhiyeessan gaafataniiru. Kanaan dura rakkoo mana jireenyaa irratti kan ture mormiin kun, filannoo dhufuuf jedhuun wal-qabatee aarii uummataa daran dabalee jira.

title: Yemeni government forces claim 1,860 Houthis ‘neutralised’
english: Yemeni government forces have announced they have neutralized 1,860 Houthi fighters through over 2,100 targeted operations as part of the new 'Dawn of Yemen' military campaign. This offensive aims to reclaim territories held by the rebels since 2014, including the capital city of Sanaa. Fighting has recently intensified around critical shipping lanes near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait following deadly Houthi drone and missile attacks on Saudi Arabian airports.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት ሃይሎች 'የየመን ንጋት' በተሰኘው አዲስ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ከ2,100 በላይ የታለሙ ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸም 1,860 የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን ገለልተኛ ማድረጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ዘመቻ ከ2014 ጀምሮ በሁቲ አማፂያን ቁጥጥር ስር ያለውን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ግዛቶችን መልሶ ለመቆጣጠር ያለመ ነው። በቅርቡ በሳውዲ አረቢያ አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሁቲዎች በተፈጸመ ገዳይ ጥቃት ሳቢያ፣ በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ወሽመጥ አቅራቢያ የሚካሄደው ውጊያ ተባብሷል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen duula waraana 'Dawn of Yemen' jedhamuun qindoomina qabuun hoogganan keessatti, haleellaa adda duree 2,100 ol raawwataniin loltoota Huti 1,860 ta'an du’a ykn madoo gochuu isaanii ibsan. Duulli kun magaalota gurguddoo dabalatee bulchiinsa Huti jala jiran fi bara 2014 irraa kaasee harka isaanii jiru hunda deebisanii to’achuuf kan karoorfame dha. Haleellaa Hutiin buufataalee xiyyaaraa Sa’udii Arabiyaa irratti raawwatan booda, waraanni qarqara galaana Baab al-Maandabitti godhamu daran hammaateera.

title: How kidnappings are hitting Nigeria’s Borno families hard
english: In Borno, Nigeria, families are facing a devastating kidnapping crisis that has drained their life savings as they struggle to pay ransom demands. Many people are forced to sell their homes and livestock to secure the release of loved ones, while others remain missing for months with no word on their safety. This wave of violence is also disrupting the education of children and creating deep emotional trauma across local communities.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ቦርኖ ግዛት የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች የገንዘብ ተቀባይ መሪዎች በሚጠይቁት ከፍተኛ ቤዛ የተነሳ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። ብዙ ቤተሰቦች የራሳቸውን ንብረት በመሸጥና ዕዳ በመግባት የታፈኑ ወዳጆቻቸውን ለማስለቀቅ ቢሞክሩም፣ አብዛኞቹ ለወራት ሳይገኙ ቀርተዋል። ይህ የጠለፋ ወንጀል ማህበረሰቡን ለከፍተኛ ስነ-ልቦናዊ ቀውስ ከመዳረጉም በላይ የህጻናትን ትምህርት በማስተጓጎል ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Boornnoo biyya Naayijeeriyaa keessatti, maatiin butama namaa isaanii fayyadamanii maallaqa gaafatan irraa kan ka'e rakkoo hamaa dinagdee keessa galaniiru. Maatiin hedduun firoota isaanii butaman hiiksisuuf qabeenya isaanii gurgurachuu fi liqii fudhachuuf dirqamaniiru, ta'us hedduun isaanii ji'oota baay'eedhaaf eessa akka jiran illee hin beekamu. Yakki butamuu kun miidhaa sammuu fi qaamaa namootarratti geessisuu bira darbee, barnoota ijoollee addaan kutuun hawaasa miidhaa jira.

title: US approves over $2bn in weapons sales to Egypt, Kuwait and UAE
english: The United States government has authorized over $2 billion in arms sales to Egypt, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates. Egypt will acquire anti-tank missiles, Kuwait will receive maintenance support for its air-defense systems, and the UAE will purchase advanced precision-guided weapons. Officials stated that these transactions are intended to support national security while maintaining the existing military balance in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከ2 ቢሊየን ዶላር በላይ የሚገመት የጦር መሳሪያ ለግብፅ፣ ለኩዌት እና ለተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬቶች ለመሸጥ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት ግብፅ ፀረ-ታንክ ሚሳኤሎችን፣ ኩዌት የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓቷን የሚያግዙ መለዋወጫዎችን፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬቶች ደግሞ ዘመናዊ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን ያገኛሉ። የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መስሪያ ቤት እነዚህ ሽያጮች በክልሉ ያለውን ወታደራዊ ሚዛን እንደማይቀይሩ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoota Gibxii, Kuweet fi Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomaniif meeshaalee waraanaa gatiin isaanii dolaara biiliyoona 2 ol ta'u gurguruuf hayyameera. Gibxii mishaalee taankii balleessan kan bitu yoo ta'u, Kuweet sirna ittisa qilleensa ishee fooyyeessuuf gargaarsa argatti, Emireetota Arabaa Gamtooman immoo meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa bitu. Mootummaan Ameerikaa gurgurtaa kana keessatti hirmaachuun isaa giddu-galeessa humna waraanaa naannichaa akka hin jijjiirre ibseera.

title: Israeli army attacks outskirts of village in Syria’s Quneitra province
english: The Israeli military conducted artillery strikes on the edges of a village in the Quneitra region of southern Syria late Wednesday. Two shells landed in local farmland, but fortunately, no casualties were recorded. Official reports confirmed the incident took place in the vicinity of al-Samdaniya al-Sharqiya.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር ረቡዕ ምሽት በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ ኩኔትራ ግዛት በሚገኝ መንደር ዳርቻ ላይ የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። ሁለት የጦር መሳሪያዎች በሰፈሩ የእርሻ መሬት ላይ ቢወድቁም፣ በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው በአል-ሳምዳኒያ አል-ሻርቅያ መንደር አቅራቢያ መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el kaleessa halkan kibba Suuriyaa godina Quneitraatti argamu qarqara baadiyaa tokkorratti rukuttaa meeshaa gurguddaa raawwate. Meeshaaleen waraanaa lama lafa qonnaa naannichatti kufanis, namoota irratti miidhaan tokkollee hin geenye. Gabaasni akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun kan mudate ganda Al-Saamdaniyaa Al-Shaarqiyaa jedhamu cinaatti dha.

title: Trump will not let Iran 'manipulate' him, White House official says
english: A White House spokesperson stated that President Trump is determined to avoid the manipulation by Iran that he believes past administrations faced. The official noted that the U.S. is currently in a strong position, citing economic pressure on Iran and American control over the Strait of Hormuz. Consequently, the administration is prepared to watch the Iranian economy continue its decline while ensuring oil shipments through the region remain secure.
amharic: የኋይት ሀውስ ባለስልጣን እንደተናገሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የቀድሞ የአሜሪካ መሪዎች እንደደረሰባቸው የሚያምኑትን የኢራን ተፅእኖ እንደማይፈቅዱ ገልጸዋል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና በመፍጠር እና የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን በመቆጣጠር ጠንካራ አቋም ላይ እንደሚገኝ ተገልጿል። በዚህም መሰረት ዋሽንግተን የኢራን ኢኮኖሚ እየተዳከመ እንዲሄድ በመፍቀድ በክልሉ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ስራዎች እንዲቀጥሉ ለማድረግ አቅዳለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyaalessaa akka jedhanitti, Preezdaant Traamp hoggantoonni Ameerikaa kanaan dura irra turan akka jedhanitti, dhiibbaa fi gochaa gowwoomsuu mootummaan Iraan raawwachaa ture akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Ameerikaan diinagdee Iraan irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuudhaan fi daandii galaana Hormuz to’achuudhaan bakka cimaa irra akka jirtu beekameera. Kanaafuu, mootummaan Ameerikaa diinagdeen Iraan akka kufaa deemuu hordofaa, daandiin boba’aa kun immoo nagaan akka itti fufuuf qophii ta’uu isaa ibsameera.

title: Iran says it 'clearly and firmly' set conditions to end war
english: Iran's foreign ministry has announced that it has established specific terms to resolve the ongoing regional conflicts and restore stability in the Persian Gulf. Officials stated that their formal response to American suggestions will be communicated via neutral third parties. Additionally, Iran has reached a mutual agreement with Oman to ensure secure navigation and transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር አሁን ባለው የክልል ግጭት መፍትሄ ለመስጠት እና በፋርስ ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ ሰላምን ለማስፈን ግልጽ ሁኔታዎችን እንዳስቀመጠ አስታውቋል። ሀገሪቱ ለአሜሪካ ያላትን ምላሽ በገለልተኛ አሸማጋዮች በኩል እንደምታስተላልፍ ገልጻለች። በተጨማሪም ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የመጓጓዣ መስመሮችን ለማረጋገጥ ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan, waraana naannichaa dhaabuufi nagaa garba Persia deebisuuf haala murteessaa ta'e qopheeffachuu isaa beeksiseera. Yaada fi dhiyeessii gama Ameerikaa irraa dhufeef deebii kan kennan giddii galeeyyii fayyadamuun akka ta'e ibsameera. Kana malees, Iraan fi Omaan daandiiwwan galaana Hormuz nagaan akka darban waliigaltee irra ga'aniiru.

title: Palestinians reflect as they mark three years since the beginning of Israel's genocide in Gaza
english: Palestinians in Gaza are commemorating three years of intense conflict that has caused widespread death, displacement, and infrastructure destruction. Official reports indicate that over 74,000 people have been killed, with the majority of homes and buildings rendered uninhabitable. As winter approaches, over a million displaced residents are struggling to survive in makeshift tents and damaged structures.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን ከፍተኛ ሞት፣ መፈናቀል እና የንብረት ውድመት ያስከተለውን የሶስት ዓመት ጦርነት እያሰቡ ይገኛሉ። ይፋዊ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ከ74,000 በላይ ሰዎች የተገደሉ ሲሆን፣ አብዛኛዎቹ መኖሪያ ቤቶችና ህንጻዎች ወድመዋል። ክረምት እየቀረበ ባለበት በአሁኑ ወቅት፣ ከአንድ ሚሊዮን በላይ የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች በተጎዱ ቤቶችና በድንኳኖች ውስጥ ለከባድ የኑሮ ችግር ተጋልጠዋል።
oromo: Uummanni Gaza keessa jiraatu waraana waggaa sadii guutuu isaan mudate kan lubbuu namaa galaafate, ummata buqqise fi bu'uraalee misoomaa barbadeesse yaadaa jira. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, namoonni 74,000 ol ta'an ajjeefamanii, manneen hedduunis barbadoofamaniiru. Yeroo gannii dhiyaachaa jiru kana, namoonni miliyoona tokko ol ta'an buqqa'anii bakkeewwan manca'aniifi dunkaana keessa rakkachaa jiru.

title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
english: Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman, has passed away following her forced eviction from a Madrid apartment she occupied for over 70 years. Her removal due to extreme rent hikes became a national symbol of Spain's housing crisis, triggering widespread protests and political debate. Although the property owners eventually offered her a chance to return, the offer came too late as her health had already declined after the eviction.
amharic: በማድሪድ ለሰባ ዓመታት በላይ ሲኖሩበት ከነበረው ቤታቸው በግድ የተባረሩት የ87 ዓመቷ ማሪካርመን አባስካል ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። የኪራይ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመርን ተከትሎ የተከሰተው ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በስፔን ውስጥ ለተነሳው የቤት አቅርቦት ችግር እና የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ዋነኛ መነሻ ሆኗል። የቤቱ ባለቤቶች መልሰው እንዲገቡ ቢፈቅዱም፣ የጤና መታወክ የገጠማቸው እኚህ አዛውንት መፍትሄው ሳይደርስላቸው ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Dubartiin umrii 87 kan ta'an Maricarmen Abascal, mana waggaa 70 ol keessa jiraatan irraa erga humnaan baafamanii booda du'aniiru. Rakkoo mana jireenyaa Ispeen keessa jiruuf mallattoo kan ta'an Abascal, mindaan mana jireenyaa isaanii baay'ee waan dabaleef dirqamaan baafamuun isaanii biyyattii keessatti mormii guddaa kaasee ture. Abbootiin qabeenyaa boodarratti manicha akka deebi'anii seenan hayyamanii turus, erga qe'ee isaanii irraa ari'amanii booda fayyummaan isaanii waan miidhameef utuu hin turin lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: Israelis mourn 7 October attack victims three years after deadly Hamas raid
english: Israel recently marked the third anniversary of the October 7 Hamas-led attacks, which resulted in the deaths of approximately 1,200 people and the abduction of hundreds more. Families and survivors held memorial services to honor the victims, including those killed at the Nova music festival. Meanwhile, the ongoing conflict has led to a massive humanitarian crisis and tens of thousands of deaths in Gaza since Israel launched its military response.
amharic: እስራኤል በሃማስ መሪነት የተፈጸመው ጥቃት በሦስተኛው ዓመት መታሰቢያ ላይ የተጎጂዎችን ቤተሰቦች እና የተረፉትን በማሰባሰብ የሟቾችን መታሰቢያ አክብራለች። እ.ኤ.አ በጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት 1,200 የሚደርሱ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ብዙዎች ታግተው ተወስደዋል። ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ምላሽ ተከትሎ በጋዛ በደረሰው ጦርነት ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው የፍልስጤም ዜጎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ የሰብአዊ ቀውሱም አሁንም ድረስ የቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el guyyaa weerara Hagayya 7, 2023 dhaabbata Haamaas gaggeesse waggaa sadii dura ture yaadannoo gaddi guutee yaadatteetti. Weerara sanaan namoonni 1,200 ol ta'an ajjeefamanii hedduun immoo butamanii turan. Israa'el tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhatteen walqabatee Gaazaa keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ajjeefamanii balaan namoomaa cimaan hanga ammaatti itti fufee jira.

title: ‘No to the father, no to the son’: Thousands march in Rio against Bolsonaro
english: Thousands of protesters gathered in Rio de Janeiro to demonstrate against Senator Flavio Bolsonaro following his success in the first round of Brazil's presidential election. Demonstrators expressed deep concerns about a potential return to far-right governance and the potential threat to democratic values. Flavio Bolsonaro, who is the son of convicted former president Jair Bolsonaro, is now set to face current President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a runoff election on October 25.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ የመጀመሪያ ዙር ውጤትን ተከትሎ ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮን በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በሪዮ ዲጄኔሮ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የቀኝ ዘመም አስተሳሰብ ወደ ስልጣን በመመለስ ዲሞክራሲያዊ እሴቶችን ያናጋል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ጃየር ቦልሶናሮ ልጅ የሆኑት ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ፣ አሁን ካለው ፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ጋር በጥቅምት 25 በሚካሄደው ሁለተኛ ዙር የምርጫ ውድድር ይጋጠማሉ።
oromo: Filannoo pirezidantummaa Biraazil keessatti seenaatar Filaaviyoo Boolsonaaroon erga injifannoo argatanii booda, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman magaalaa Riyoo dii Zheeneerootti mormii dhageessisaniiru. Mormitootni kun sirni gara mirgaatti qajeele kun deebi'ee aangoo qabachuun demokraasii biyyattii rakkoof saaxila jechuun yaaddoo qabu. Ilmi pirezidantii kanaan duraa Jaayir Boolsonaaroo kan ta'an Filaaviyoon, pirezidantii amma jiran Luwiiz Iinaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa wajjin filannoo marsaa lammaffaa Muddee 25 gaggeeffamu irratti kan wal dorgoman ta'a.

title: Judge orders officials to preserve Pike execution evidence
english: A Nashville judge has directed Tennessee authorities to secure all physical and recorded evidence linked to Christa Pike’s unsuccessful lethal injection procedures. Her legal team argues that the two failed attempts to carry out the death penalty qualify as unconstitutionally cruel punishment. This order ensures that items like medical equipment, drugs, and relevant recordings remain available for upcoming legal review.
amharic: የናሽቪል ዳኛ የቴነሲ ባለስልጣናት ከክሪስታ ፓይክ ያልተሳካ የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸም ጋር የተያያዙ ማስረጃዎችን በሙሉ እንዲጠብቁ አዘዋል። የፓይክ ጠበቆች ሁለቱ ያልተሳኩ የሞት ፍርድ ሙከራዎች ህገ-ወጥ እና ጭካኔ የተሞላባቸው ናቸው በማለት ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ትእዛዝ የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች፣ መርፌዎች እና ሌሎች ተዛማጅ ማስረጃዎች ለህግ ምርመራ እንዲቆዩ ያደርጋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa magaalaa Naashviil, hoggantoonni Teenesii yaalii ajjeechaa Christa Pike kan hin milkoofne irratti ragaalee hunda akka qabanii turan ajajaniiru. Looyyoonni Pike akka jedhanitti, yaaliiwwan ajjeechaa lama kan hin milkoofne sun adabbii garmalee hamaa fi seeraan alaa dha. Ajajni kun meeshaalee yaalii, qorichoota fi sagaleewwan galmeeffaman dhimma seeraa fuulduraaf akka eegaman mirkaneessa.

title: Pro-Palestine university groups march in London on October 7 anniversary
english: On the first anniversary of the October 7 attacks, student groups in London organized a protest to show support for Palestine. The demonstration proceeded despite official requests from local police to delay the event. The march highlights ongoing student activism regarding the situation in Gaza.
amharic: የጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት አንደኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን ምክንያት በማድረግ በለንደን የሚገኙ የተማሪዎች ቡድኖች ለፍልስጤም ድጋፋቸውን ለመግለጽ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። የለንደን ፖሊስ ሰልፉን ለሌላ ጊዜ እንዲያስተላልፉ ቢጠይቅም፣ ተቃዋሚዎቹ ግን ጥሪውን ሳይቀበሉ ሰልፉን አካሂደዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ በጋዛ ያለውን ሁኔታ በተመለከተ የተማሪዎችን ቀጣይነት ያለው ተቃውሞ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa yaadannoo haleellaa Mudde 7ffaa (October 7) waggaa tokkooffaa ilaalchisee, gareewwan barattootaa London keessatti deeggarsa Palasxiniif hiriira bahan. Poolisiin London hiriira kana akka dabarsan gaafatus, barattoonni garuu diduun hiriiricha gaggeessaniiru. Hiriirri kun haala Gza keessatti raawwatamaa jiru irratti barattoonni harka qabaachuu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump on why he thinks he deserves the Nobel Peace Prize
english: Former President Donald Trump has expressed that he believes he should be awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. He is currently one of 287 nominees being considered for this year's honor. Trump suggested that it would be unfair if the committee decided not to select him for the prestigious award.
amharic: ቀድሞ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ፕሬዚዳንት የነበሩት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኖቤል የሰላም ሽልማትን ማግኘት እንደሚገባቸው ገልጸዋል። እርሳቸው ዘንድሮ ለሽልማቱ ከታጩ 287 ሰዎች መካከል አንዱ ናቸው። ትራምፕ የሽልማት ኮሚቴው ለእርሳቸው ካልሰጠ ለሽልማቱ ክብር ተገቢ አይደለም ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii Ameerikaa kan turan Doonaald Traamp badhaasa nageenyaa Noobeel argachuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Isaanis badhaasa kanaaf barana kan dhiyaatan namoota 287 keessaa tokko dha. Traamp komiiteen badhaasichaa isaan yoo filachuu baate badhaasichaaf akka tuffii ta'e dubbataniiru.

title: South Africa host Australia who battle more than ‘Sandpapergate’ memories
english: Australia is returning to South Africa for a Test series for the first time since the infamous 2018 ball-tampering scandal. South Africa, the current World Test Championship holders, are preparing to use their spin bowlers as a primary weapon on the Durban pitch. Meanwhile, Australia enters the competition looking to recover their form following a recent and unexpected home Test loss against Bangladesh.
amharic: አውስትራሊያ ከ2018 የኳስ ማጭበርበር ቅሌት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የቴስት ግጥሚያ ለማድረግ ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ተመልሳለች። የዓለም የቴስት ሻምፒዮና አሸናፊ የሆነችው ደቡብ አፍሪካ በደርባን ሜዳ ላይ በሚደረገው ጨዋታ የሚሽከረከሩ ኳስ አቀባባዮቿን (ስፒን ቦውለሮች) እንደ ዋና የጥቃት መሳሪያ ለመጠቀም አቅዳለች። አውስትራሊያ በበኩሏ ከባንግላዴሽ ጋር በሜዳዋ የደረሰባትን ያልተጠበቀ ሽንፈት ተከትሎ፣ አቋሟን ለማሻሻል በመጫወት ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Awustiraaliyaan booda falmii qulqullina kubbaa bara 2018 ishee mudatee ture, erga sana booda yeroo jalqabaatiif qormaata 'Test' taasisuuf gara Afrikaa Kibbaatti deebiteetti. Afrikaan Kibbaa, moo'attuun g<bos>0'a Test Addunyaa, dirree Durban irratti taphachuuf itti fayyadamtoota 'spin' ishee akka meeshaa ijoo lolaatti itti fayyadamuuf qophooftee jirti. title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
english: Three years after the October 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks, many Israelis are calling for an independent inquiry into the catastrophic security and intelligence failures. Survivors and relatives of victims are demanding that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and other leaders accept responsibility for the lack of preparation despite prior warnings. Although the attack resulted in 1,200 deaths and hundreds of hostages, no official investigation has been conducted to explain how the tragedy occurred.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 በሃማስ የተመራው ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ ሶስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ በርካታ እስራኤላውያን በጸጥታ እና በስለላ ክፍፍሎች ላይ ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ነው። የተረፉት ሰዎች እና የሟች ቤተሰቦች ቀደምት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ቢኖሩም ዝግጅት ባለማድረጋቸው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና ሌሎች መሪዎች ሀላፊነት እንዲወስዱ ይፈልጋሉ። ጥቃቱ 1,200 ሰዎችን መግደሉ እና በርካታ ሰዎችን ማገቱ የሚታወስ ቢሆንም፣ አሳዛኙ ክስተት እንዴት ሊከሰት እንደቻለ እስካሁን ይፋዊ ምርመራ አልተደረገም።
oromo: Hujiiwwan garee Hamaas irraa qindaa'anii Muddee 7, 2023 raawwataman booda waggaa sadii guututti, Israa'eloonni hedduun rakkoo nageenyaa fi odeeffannoo isaan mudate irratti qorannoo walabaa akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru. Miidhamtoonni fi maatiin miidhamtootaa, akeekkachiisa duraan kennamee ture utuu jiruu qophiin gahaa waan hin godhamneef, Muummichi Ministeeraa Beniyaamin Netanyaahuu fi hoggantoonni biroo itti gaafatamummaa akka fudhatan barbaadu. Miidhaan kun lubbuu namoota 1,200 galaafatee fi namoota hedduu butus, balaan kun akkamitti akka uumame qorannoon seeraa hanga ammaatti hin gaggeeffamne.

title: Canada suspends plans to expand assisted dying to people with mental illness
english: The Canadian government has decided to indefinitely halt the expansion of its medically assisted dying program to individuals whose only underlying condition is mental illness. Justice Minister Sean Fraser explained that the delay is necessary because there is no national agreement on how to implement this safely. While this change pauses access for mental health patients, the government is also introducing new legislation regarding advanced consent for those with incurable, progressive diseases.
amharic: የካናዳ መንግስት የአእምሮ ህመም ብቻ ላለባቸው ሰዎች የህክምና እርዳታ ያለው ሞት ፕሮግራምን የማስፋፋት እቅዱን ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ማቆሙን አስታውቋል። የፍትህ ሚኒስትሩ ሾን ፍሬዘር እንደገለጹት ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው በአፈፃፀሙ ላይ ሀገራዊ መግባባት ባለመፈጠሩ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት የካናዳ መንግስት ይህንን እቅድ ከማቆሙ ጎን ለጎን፣ የማይድኑ በሽታዎች ላለባቸው ሰዎች አስቀድሞ ፈቃድ የመስጠትን ጉዳይ የሚመለከት አዲስ ህግ ለማስተዋወቅ እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Kaanaadaa sagantaa gargaarsa du'aa fayyaa namoota dhukkuba sammuu qofaan miidhamanitti babal'isuuf qabame ture yeroodhaaf dhaabuuf murteesseera. Ministirri Haqaa Sean Fraser akka ibsanitti, murtoon kun kan fudhatame akkaataa hojiirra oolmaa isaa irratti waliigalteen waan hin jirreef dha. Mootummaan dhimmicha ilaalchisee yaada isaa kan jijjiire yoo ta'u, gama biraan ammoo namoota dhukkuba fayyuu hin dandeenye qabanif hayyama duraa ilaalchisee seera haaraa baasuuf karoorfataa jira.

title: Kenya on high alert amid concern over screening after first Ebola death
english: Kenya has significantly increased its health security measures following the country's first confirmed death from Ebola. Authorities are taking urgent action to address public worries regarding potential weaknesses in border screening processes. These enhanced efforts aim to prevent the further spread of the virus across the nation.
amharic: ኬንያ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የመጀመሪያው የኢቦላ ታማሚ ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ የጤና ጥበቃ እርምጃዎችን አጠናክራለች። መንግስት በድንበር መቆጣጠሪያ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ያሉ ጉድለቶች ሊያስከትሉ የሚችሉትን ስጋት ለመቅረፍ አስቸኳይ ስራዎችን እየሰራ ይገኛል። እነዚህ ጥረቶች ቫይረሱ ወደ ሌሎች አካባቢዎች እንዳይዛመት ለመከላከል ያለሙ ናቸው።
oromo: Keeniyaan dhukkuba Ebolaatiin namni jalqabaa biyyattii keessatti du'uu isaa hordofee, tarkaanfii eegumsa fayyaa cimaa fudhattee jirti. Mootummaan daangaa biyyattii irratti qorannoo fayyaa irratti hanqina jiraachuu mala jedhamee sodaatamu hambisuuf tattaaffii ariifachiisaa taasisaa jira. title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
english: The French government has temporarily banned the use of stun grenades during student protests following an incident where a 15-year-old boy lost his hand. Authorities are investigating conflicting reports regarding how the injury occurred, with students claiming the boy was directly hit and police arguing he picked up the device. Amidst widespread unrest that has led to numerous school closures and arrests, officials are now reviewing whether police tactics during these demonstrations have been excessively forceful.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ በአንድ የ15 ዓመት ወጣት እጅ ላይ በደረሰ ከባድ ጉዳት ምክንያት መንግስት ተማሪዎች በሚያደርጉት ተቃውሞ ላይ የድንጋጤ ቦንቦችን (stun grenades) መጠቀም አግዷል። የጉዳቱ መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ በተመለከተ በተማሪዎች እና በፖሊስ መካከል የተለያየ መግለጫ በመኖሩ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል። በተቀሰቀሰው ተቃውሞ በርካታ ትምህርት ቤቶች በመዘጋታቸው እና ከፍተኛ ግጭቶች በመፈጠራቸው፣ የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት የጸጥታ ሃይሎች የተጠቀሙበት የሃይል አጠቃቀም ተገቢነት ላይ ማጣራት ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Faransaayi keessatti barataa waggaa 15 ta'e tokko harka isaa erga dhabee booda, mootummaan qondaaltoonni kun hiriira barattootaa irratti meeshaa 'stun grenades' jedhamu fayyadamuu akka dhaaban ajajeera. Miidhaan kun kan ga'e akkamitti akka ta'e ilaalchisee yaanni barattootaa fi poolisii waan wal faalleessuuf qorannoon eegalameera. Hiriirri kun babal'atee mana barumsaa hedduu erga cufsiisee fi namoota baay'een erga hidhaman booda, mootummaan tarkaanfiin poolisiin fudhate haqa-qabeessa ta'uu fi dhiisuu isaa qorachaa jira.

title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
english: President Trump intends to discuss the mysterious death of a laboratory worker at a Siberian plague research center with Vladimir Putin. While the U.S. is seeking more details, the Kremlin has denied that any such call is planned and insists that Russia followed proper reporting procedures. Meanwhile, the World Health Organization is urging Russian authorities to be transparent about the incident to assess any potential health risks, as investigations into the woman's cause of death continue.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በሳይቤሪያ በሚገኝ የወረርሽኝ ምርምር ማዕከል ውስጥ የሰራተኛን ሞት በተመለከተ ከቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ለመወያየት ማቀዳቸውን ገልጸዋል። አሜሪካ ጉዳዩን በተመለከተ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎችን እየጠየቀች ቢሆንም፣ የክሬምሊን ቃል አቀባይ እንዲህ አይነት የስልክ ውይይት እንዳልተቀጠረ እና ሩሲያ የአለም አቀፍ ደንቦችን እንደተከተለች አስታውቀዋል። በዚህ ወቅት፣ የአለም የጤና ድርጅት የህዝብ ጤና ስጋትን ለመገምገም ሩሲያ ስለጉዳዩ ግልጽ መረጃ እንድትሰጥ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp lubbuun darbuu hojjetaa laaboraatoorii qorannoo dhibee vaayirasii Siibeeriyaa keessatti raawwate ilaalchisee Vladimir Puutiin waliin mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Ameerikaan odeeffannoo dabalataa barbaadaa jirtus, Mootummaan Raashiyaa mariin akkasii hin karoorfamne jedhee kan haale yoo ta'u, akkaataa gabaasa isaanii sirrii akka ta'e dubbateera. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) balaa fayyaa ummataa irratti mudachuu danda'u hubachuuf jecha Raashiyaan akka iftoomina qabaattu gaafateera.

title: Zelensky condemns 'vile' large-scale Russian attacks that killed 15
english: President Volodymyr Zelensky has denounced a major Russian missile campaign that targeted multiple Ukrainian regions, resulting in at least 15 civilian deaths. The strikes heavily damaged residential buildings in areas including Pryluky, Kyiv, and Dnipro, with rescue teams continuing to search for survivors trapped under the debris. In response to these attacks, Ukraine confirmed it carried out its own retaliatory strikes against military targets inside Russia and the Black Sea region.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በበርካታ የሀገሪቱ ክልሎች ላይ ቢያንስ 15 ሰዎችን የገደለውን መጠነ ሰፊ የሩሲያ የሮኬት ጥቃት በጽኑ አውግዘዋል። ጥቃቱ በፕሪሉኪ፣ በኪየቭ እና በዲኒፕሮ በሚገኙ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተጠቁ ሰዎችን ፍለጋ እያደረጉ ነው። ለዚህ ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ ወታደራዊ ኢላማዎች እና በጥቁር ባህር ላይ ተመጣጣኝ እርምጃ መውሰዷን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenskii haleellaa rookeetii Ruusiyaan guutuu Yukreenitti raawwattee fi lubbuu namoota 15 galaafate akka malee balaaleeffataniiru. Haleellaan kun magaalota akka Priilukii, Kiyeev fi Diiniproo keessatti manneen jireenyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira; ammas ogeeyyiin gargaarsa hatattamaa diigamtee jala namoota hafan barbaadaa jiru. Haleellaa kanaaf deebii kennuuf, Yukreen lafa Ruusiyaa fi naannoo Galaana Gurraacha keessatti bakkeewwan waraanaa irratti haleellaa of irraa ittisuu raawwachuu ishee mirkaneessiteetti.

title: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta signs new contract with Premier League champions
english: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has extended his contract with the club until 2030 following their recent Premier League title victory. Since taking charge in 2019, Arteta has successfully led the team back to the top of English football and their first Champions League final in two decades. The club's leadership expressed strong confidence in his continued vision to build further success at the Emirates.
amharic: የአርሰናሉ አሰልጣኝ ሚኬል አርቴታ ክለቡ የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ዋንጫን ካሸነፈ በኋላ ውላቸውን እስከ 2030 ድረስ ማራዘማቸው ተገለጸ። አርቴታ በ2019 አርሰናልን መምራት ከጀመሩበት ጊዜ አንስቶ ቡድኑን ወደ እንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ አናት በመመለስ ለሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ያልታየ ስኬት እንዲያሳካ አስችለውታል። የክለቡ ባለቤቶች በአሰልጣኙ ስኬታማ የሥራ አመራር ያላቸውን እምነት በመግለጽ ለቀጣይ የላቀ ውጤት አብረው እንደሚሰሩ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee Arsenal Mikel Arteta injifannoo Premier League booda waliigaltee isaa hanga bara 2030 tti dheereffateera. Arteta erga bara 2019 irraa jalqabee garee kana hogganuu jalqabee booda, gareen Arsenal guddina guddaa agarsiisee fi waancaa biyyattii injifachuu danda'eera. Qondaalonni garee kanaa hojii fi mul'ata leenjisichaa irratti amantii guddaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, fuuldurattis milkaa'ina caaluuf waliin akka hojjetan ibsaniiru.

title: Miles away from Argentina, Messi’s farewell hits home for his Indian fans
english: Indian superfan Yadil Iqbal traveled over 15,000 kilometers from Kerala to Argentina to witness Lionel Messi’s final international match. Despite initially lacking a ticket, Iqbal successfully purchased one at a high cost shortly after arriving in Buenos Aires. His journey highlights the immense passion Messi inspires in India, where thousands of dedicated followers view the football icon as a local hero.
amharic: ያዲል ኢቅባል የተባለ የህንድ የሊዮኔል ሜሲ ደጋፊ፣ የሜሲን የመጨረሻ ዓለም አቀፍ ጨዋታ ለመመልከት ከኬረላ እስከ አርጀንቲና ከ15,000 ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ተጉዟል። ምንም እንኳን ሲነሳ የጨዋታ ቲኬት ባይኖረውም፣ ቡነስ አይረስ እንደደረሰ ውድ ዋጋ ከፍሎ ቲኬቱን ማግኘት ችሏል። ይህ ጉዞ ሜሲ በህንድ ህዝብ ዘንድ ያለውን ትልቅ አድናቆት የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ብዙ የህንድ እግር ኳስ አፍቃሪዎች ኮከቡን እንደ የገዛ ወገናቸው ይቆጥሩታል።
oromo: Yadil Iqbal kan jedhamu fi guddicha biyya Indiyaa keessatti kan beekamu, tapha dhumaa kan Lionel Messi ilaaluuf biyya Indiyaa irraa gara Arjantiinaatti qaxxaamura 15,000 km imaleera. Yeroo inni imala isaa jalqabu tikeetii taphichaa kan hin qabne ta'us, magaalaa Buunos Ayires erga ga'ee booda gatii guddaa kaffalee tikeetii bitachuu danda'eera. Imalli isaa kun jaalala guddaa namoonni Indiyaa taphataa kanaaf qaban kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, Messi biyya isaanii keessatti akka nama ganda isaanii keessaa tokkootti ilaallama.

title: Justina Shiroka Pula: Kosovo’s new president, elected during a crisis
english: Justina Shiroka Pula has been elected as the new president of Kosovo following a political deadlock and widespread protests regarding war crimes convictions. Parliament reached a last-minute compromise to appoint her, preventing the need for snap elections that could have further destabilized the nation. Her election was supported by both the ruling party and the opposition, who also agreed to address legal concerns surrounding the Hague-based court handling former liberation army leaders.
amharic: ጀስቲና ሺሮካ ፑላ በጦር ወንጀል ውሳኔዎች ሳቢያ በተፈጠረው ውዝግብ እና ተቃውሞዎች መካከል የኮሶቮ አዲስ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። የፓርላማው አባላት ሀገሪቱን ወደ ቀውስ ሊያስገባ የሚችለውን አዲስ ምርጫ ለማስቀረት ሲሉ በስምምነት እርሳቸውን ለመምረጥ ችለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በመንግስት እና በተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች መካከል የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ የጦር ወንጀል ክሶችን የሚመለከተውን የፍርድ ቤት አሰራር ለማሻሻል የሚያስችል ስምምነትንም ያካተተ ነው።
oromo: Justina Shiroka Pula rakkoo siyaasaa fi hiriira mormii irratti hundaa'e booda pirezidaantii biyya Koosovoo ta'anii filatamaniiru. Mana maree biyyattii keessatti walii galteen waaree booda irra ga'ame kun, biyyattiin filannoo dursee gaggeeffamuun akka hin rakkanneefi tasgabbii akka argattu taasiseera. Filannoon ishee kun mootummaa fi mormituu gidduutti kan waliigalame yoo ta'u, walii galteen kun dhimmoota seeraa fi waraana darbee wajjin walqabatu irratti xiyyeeffata.

title: US military aid to Israel continues three years into Gaza genocide
english: Despite the ongoing conflict in Gaza reaching its third year, the United States continues to provide unconditional military and financial support to Israel. Both the Biden and Trump administrations have maintained this policy, even as regional tensions escalate and international criticism grows. Since the war began in October 2023, over 74,000 Palestinians have been killed, while U.S. officials remain committed to supplying weapons and diplomatic backing.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ሶስተኛ ዓመቱን ቢይዝም፣ አሜሪካ ለእስራኤል የምታደርገውን ያልተቋረጠ ወታደራዊ እና የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ቀጥላለች። የባይደን እና የትራምፕ አስተዳደሮች በክልሉ ውጥረቱ እየጨመረ ቢሄድም ይህንን ድጋፍ በአቋማቸው ቀጥለውበታል። ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በተካሄደው ጦርነት ከ74,000 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን የተገደሉ ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት አሁንም ለእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያ እና ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ድጋፍ መስጠቱን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Waraanni Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiru waggaa sadaffaa isaa irra kan gahe ta'us, Ameerikaan gargaarsa waraanaa fi maallaqaa gara Israa'elitti ergitu itti fufteetti. Bulchiinsi Bidenis ta'e Trump, naannichatti waldhabdeen dabaluu fi mormiin idil-addunyaa jiraatuus, deggarsa kana hin dhaabne. Waraana Onkololeessa 2023 kaasee gaggeeffameen namoonni Palastaayinii 74,000 ol du'aniiru; ta'us mootummaan Ameerikaa meeshaa waraanaa fi deggarsa dippilomaasii Israa'eliif kennuu itti fufeera.

title: Doha Debates: Should We Trust the News?
english: Doha Debates recently explored the critical question of whether the public can place their trust in modern news media. The discussion examined the challenges of media credibility in an era of complex global conflicts and information overload. Participants engaged in a thoughtful dialogue about how audiences should navigate today's journalism landscape.
amharic: የዶሃ ክርክሮች በቅርቡ የህብረተሰቡ መገናኛ ብዙሃንን ማመን ይገባቸዋል ወይ የሚለውን አስፈላጊ ጥያቄ ዳስሰዋል። ውይይቱ በተወሳሰቡ አለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች እና የመረጃ ብዛት በተሞላበት ዘመን የዜና ተአማኒነትን ፈተናዎች መርምሯል። ተሳታፊዎች ተመልካቾች የዛሬውን የጋዜጠኝነት አለም እንዴት መረዳት እንዳለባቸው በመወያየት ሀሳባቸውን አጋርተዋል።
oromo: Mariiwwan Doha dhiheenya kana gaaffii murteessaa ta'e kan ummanni oduuwwan ammayyaa irratti amantaa qabaachuu qaba moo hin qabu jedhu irratti mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun yeroo walitti bu'iinsa addunyaa fi odeeffannoo hedduun itti baay'ate kanatti amanamummaa miidiyaa irratti gufuuwwan jiran qoratee jira. Hirmaattotni dhaggeeffattootni haala gabaasa oduu ammayyaa keessa jiru akkamitti hubachuu akka qaban irratti yaada waljijjiiraniiru.

title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
english: Residents of Kibbutz Nir Oz are facing the difficult task of deciding how to rebuild their community following the devastating October 7 attacks. The violence left a quarter of the population either murdered or taken hostage, leaving behind a scarred landscape and traumatized families. Despite the immense loss, some survivors are determined to return to their homes to honor the memory of those they lost.
amharic: የኒር ኦዝ ኪቡትዝ ነዋሪዎች በጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት በደረሰባቸው ከፍተኛ ውድመት ምክንያት ማህበረሰባቸውን እንዴት መልሰው መገንባት እንደሚችሉ ለመወሰን እየታገሉ ነው። ጥቃቱ የህዝቡን አንድ አራተኛ የሚሆኑትን የገደለ ወይም የታገተ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለቀሪዎቹ ትልቅ የስነ-ልቦና ጠባሳ ትቶ አልፏል። ከደረሰው ከፍተኛ መከራ አንጻር፣ አንዳንድ የተረፉ ነዋሪዎች የሞቱትን ወዳጆቻቸውን ለማሰብ ወደ ቀድሞ ቤታቸው ለመመለስ ቆርጠዋል።
oromo: Namoonni Kibbutz Nir Oz jiraatan, haleellaa Sadaasa 7 raawwatameen booda hawaasa isaanii akkamitti akka deebisanii ijaaran irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru. Haleellaan kun namoota naannichaa keessaa harka afur keessaa tokko ajjeese ykn butee deemeera, kunis miidhaa guddaa fi gadda keessa jiraattotaa darbe keessa jiru kutee jira. Miidhaa kana hunda keessa iyyuu, namoonni haleellaa sana irraa oolan tokko tokko, kanneen du'an yaadachuuf gara mana isaanii deebi'uuf murteessaniiru.

title: What is pneumonic plague and how does it spread?
english: Pneumonic plague is a severe, life-threatening lung infection caused by the Yersinia pestis bacteria, which is typically carried by small rodents and their fleas. While it is rare, the disease can spread between humans through airborne droplets when an infected person coughs. The World Health Organization is currently investigating a researcher's death in Russia to determine the cause, though authorities note that others in contact with the individual remain healthy.
amharic: ኒውሞኒክ ፕሌግ በትንንሽ አይጦች እና ቁንጫዎች በሚሸከሙ ባክቴሪያዎች የሚከሰት በጣም አደገኛ የሆነ የሳንባ ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ይህ በሽታ በሰዎች መካከል በሳል አማካኝነት በአየር ጠብታዎች ሊተላለፍ የሚችል ቢሆንም በአንጻራዊነት አልፎ አልፎ የሚከሰት ነው። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት በሩሲያ ውስጥ የተከሰተውን የአንድ ተመራማሪ ሞት እየመረመረ ሲሆን እስካሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ከሟቹ ጋር ግንኙነት የነበራቸው ሰዎች በበሽታው እንዳልተያዙ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Pneumonic plague dhukkuba sombaa hamaa fi lubbuu miidhuu danda'u yoo ta'u, kunis vaayirasii ykn baakteriyaa hantuuta xixiqqoo fi quncaan darbuudha. Dhukkubni kun namoota gidduutti qufaan, hafuura ykn cophaa qilleensa keessa jiruun darbuu kan danda'u yoo ta'u, gosa dhukkuba kanaa keessaa kan baay'ee yaaddessudha. Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa du'a qorataa tokkoo kan Ruusiyaatti mudate ilaalchisee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru; hanga ammaatti namoonni qorataa sana waliin qunnamtii qaban vaayirasicha akka hin qabne mirkanaa'eera.

title: Ex-US spy who stashed gold bars in his home admits to $200m scam
english: A former CIA officer named David Rush has pleaded guilty to a $200 million fraud scheme involving fake government contracts and the misuse of public funds for personal luxury assets. During the investigation, authorities discovered hundreds of gold bars in his residence. Additionally, Rush admitted to compromising national security by revealing the identity of a secret human source to a foreign government.
amharic: ዴቪድ ራሽ የተባሉ የቀድሞ የሲአይኤ ኦፊሰር በውሸት የመንግስት ኮንትራቶች እና የመንግስት ገንዘብን ለግል ጥቅም በማዋል የ200 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ማጭበርበር ፈጽመው እንደነበር አምነዋል። በምርመራው ወቅት ባለስልጣናት በቤታቸው ውስጥ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የወርቅ አሞሌዎችን አግኝተዋል። በተጨማሪም ራሽ አንድን ሚስጥራዊ የመረጃ ምንጭ ለውጭ መንግስት አሳልፈው በመስጠት ብሄራዊ ደህንነትን አደጋ ላይ መጣላቸውን አምነዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan duraanii CIA, Deevid Raash, kontiraata sobaa fi qabeenya mootummaa fayyadamuun malaammaltummaa $200 miliyoonaa raawwachuu isaa amaneera. Qorannoo kanaan walqabatee, abbootiin taayitaa manasaa keessaa warqee baayyee argataniiru. Kana malees, Raash odeeffannoo icitii ta'e tokko mootummaa biyya alaa tokkoof gurguruudhaan nageenya biyyoolessaa miidhuu isaa hubachiiseera.

title: Libya’s parliament removes Speaker Saleh after 12 years as discontent grows
english: Libya's eastern-based parliament has voted to remove long-time speaker Aguila Saleh after 12 years of leadership. Lawmakers replaced him with Al-Salhin Abdelnabi al-Obeidi following widespread dissatisfaction with Saleh's tendency to make unilateral decisions. This leadership change occurs amid ongoing political instability and reflects a shift in power dynamics within eastern Libya's influential factions.
amharic: የሊቢያ የምስራቃዊው ፓርላማ ለ12 ዓመታት በስልጣን ላይ የነበሩትን አፈ-ጉባኤ አጊላ ሳሌህን በድምጽ ብልጫ ከስልጣን አንስቷል። የፓርላማ አባላት ከአፈ-ጉባኤው ውሳኔዎች ጋር አለመስማማታቸውን በመግለጽ አል-ሳልሂን አብደልናቢ አል-ኦቤይዲን በአዲስ አፈ-ጉባኤነት መርጠዋል። ይህ ለውጥ የተደረገው በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለው የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት እና በምስራቅ ሊቢያ ያሉ የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች የውስጥ የሥልጣን ሽኩቻ እየጠነከረ በመጣበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Parlamaan biyya Liibiyaa kan bahaa, ganna 12f aangoo irra kan turan Aggiilaa Saaleeh aangoo irraa kaasuun murteesse. Miseensonni paarlaamaa, Saaleeh marii malee murtee kennuu isaaniitti gungumuu booda, Al-Saalhiin Abdalnaabii Al-Obeeydiin bakka buusuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe yeroo biyyattiin rakkoo siyaasaa keessa jirtuufi humni baha Liibiyaa keessatti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaaluu isaa keessatti dha.

title: Three years of Israel’s genocide in Gaza: In numbers
english: Three years after the conflict in Gaza began, at least 74,000 Palestinians have been killed and over 175,000 injured due to relentless Israeli military operations. Despite a ceasefire agreement declared in October 2025, regular attacks have persisted, claiming over 1,400 more lives. Gaza's infrastructure, particularly the healthcare system, has been largely decimated, with nearly all medical facilities currently non-functional.
amharic: በጋዛ ግጭት ከተቀሰቀሰ ሶስት አመታት በኋላ፣ እስራኤል በፈጸመችው ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 74,000 ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ ከ175,000 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። እ.ኤ.አ. በጥቅምት 2025 የተደረሰውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ተከትሎም ጥቃቶች አሁንም ያልቆሙ ሲሆን፣ ከዚህ ጊዜ ወዲህ ብቻ ከ1,400 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። የጋዛ መሠረተ ልማት እና በተለይም የጤና አገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ስርዓቱ ሙሉ በሙሉ በመውደሙ ነዋሪዎች አስቸኳይ የህክምና እርዳታ ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti walitti bu'iinsi erga eegalee waggaa sadii booda, haleellaa waraana Israa'el itti fufeen namoonni Falasxiin 74,000 ol ta'an ajjeefamanii 175,000 ol immoo madaa'aniiru. Onkoloolessa 2025 waggaa darbe waliigalteen dhaabbii waraanaa labsamus, haleellaawwan guyyuu itti fufanii jiru; kana keessattis namoonni 1,400 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru. Bu'uuraaleen misoomaa Gaza, keessattuu tajaajilli fayyaa guutumaan guutuutti diigamuun isaa, ummanni gargaarsa fayyaa barbaachisaa ta'e akka hin arganne taasiseera.

title: Israelis pause to mark October 7 Hamas-attack anniversary
english: Israelis held memorial services to observe the first anniversary of the Hamas-led attacks that occurred on October 7, 2023. These events commemorate the loss of nearly 1,200 lives during the initial violence. The nation also remembered the 250 individuals who were abducted and taken into Gaza at that time.
amharic: እስራኤላውያን ጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 በሐማስ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አንደኛ ዓመት በማስታወስ መታሰቢያ ስነ-ስርዓት አካሂደዋል። በወቅቱ በተፈጸመው ጥቃት ወደ 1,200 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በዚያኑ ዕለት ወደ ጋዛ ተወስደው የነበሩትን 250 ታጋቾች በማሰብ በሀዘን ተከስተዋል።
oromo: Israa'elonni guyyaa haleellaa Hamasiin onkoloolessa 7, 2023 gaggeeffame san waggaa tokko guutuu isaa yaadannoo gaggeessaniiru. Haleellaa sanaan lubbuun namoota 1,200 ol ta'uu kan darbe yoo ta'u, namoonni 250 immoo gara gaazaatti butamanii turan. Guyyaan kun miidhaa fi miira gadadoo namoota sanaa yaadachuuf kan oole dha.

title: Tree nearly as old as US torn down to expand Mexico border wall
english: A historic cottonwood tree, estimated to be around 200 years old, has been cut down to facilitate the construction of a double border wall between the United States and Mexico. Local activists had campaigned and occupied the area for several months in a failed attempt to protect the tree. This action marks the removal of a significant natural landmark to make space for infrastructure development.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በሜክሲኮ መካከል ድርብ የድንበር ግንብ ለመገንባት ሲባል ወደ 200 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያስቆጠረ ታሪካዊ የጥጥ ዛፍ ተቆርጧል። አካባቢውን የሚጠብቁ አክቲቪስቶች ዛፉ እንዳይቆረጥ ለብዙ ወራት ሲቃወሙ እና ቦታው ላይ ሰፍረው ቢቆዩም ጥረታቸው ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል። ይህ ድርጊት ለግንባታው ሲባል አንድ ትልቅ የተፈጥሮ ቅርጽ መወገዱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Muka 'cottonwood' jedhamu kan waggaa 200 lakkoofsise tokko, daangaa Ameerikaa fi Meksikii gidduutti dallaa dachaa ijaaruuf jechuun murameera. Duulaan naannichaa turan tokko tokko muka kana eeguuf ji'oota baay'ee bakka sana buufatanii mormaa turus, carraaqqiin isaanii milkaa'uu hin dandeenye. Gochi kun babal'ina ijaarsaaf jechuun muka seenaa qabeessa ta'e tokko mancaasuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: What Israeli schools teach
english: A recent Al Jazeera report examines how the Israeli educational system portrays the history and presence of Palestinians. Interviews with students and educators suggest that Palestinian perspectives are increasingly omitted from classroom curricula. This study highlights concerns regarding how the erasure of such history influences the perception of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: አልጀዚራ ባወጣው የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባ መሰረት፣ የእስራኤል የትምህርት ሥርዓት የፍልስጤማውያንን ታሪክ እና መኖር እንዴት እንደሚያስተምር ተገምግሟል። ከተማሪዎች እና መምህራን ጋር የተደረጉ ቃለ-መጠይቆች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የፍልስጤማውያን አመለካከቶች እና ታሪክ ከትምህርት ቤት መማሪያ መጽሐፍት ውስጥ እየተሰረዙ ነው። ይህ ጥናት እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ታሪክ ከትምህርት መውጣቱ በግጭቱ ላይ ያለውን አመለካከት እንዴት እንደሚጎዳው ስጋትን ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Gabaasni Al Jazeera dhiheenya kana baase akka ibsutti, sirni barnoota Israa'el seenaa fi jiraachuu Falasxiinotaa akkamitti akka barsiisu xiinxala. Barattootaa fi barsiisota wajjin mariin taasifame akka agarsiisutti, yaanni Falasxiinotaa fi seenaan isaanii kitaaba barnootaa keessaa yeroo ammaa hir'ifamaa jira. Qorannoon kun seenaan akkasii barnoota keessaa dhabamuun isaa ilaalcha walitti bu'iinsa jiru irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabu yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
english: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, has regained consciousness and is speaking following a failed lethal injection attempt. Legal and medical experts describe her survival as an unprecedented event, as she is the first person to recover after the successful administration of execution chemicals. The state has suspended all executions for the remainder of the year while the prison commissioner has announced his resignation following the incident.
amharic: በቴነሲ ግዛት የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ፣ የተፈፀመባት ገዳይ መርፌ ሳይሳካ ቀርቶ በህይወት መትረፏ ተሰምቷል። አሁን ንቃተ ህሊናዋን መልሳ ማውራት የጀመረችው ይህች እስረኛ፣ ገዳይ መርዝ ከተወጋላት በኋላ በህይወት የተረፈች የመጀመሪያዋ ሰው እንደሆነች ባለሙያዎች ገልጸዋል። ይህ ያልተለመደ ክስተት ተከትሎ፣ የቴነሲ ግዛት አስተዳደር በዚህ አመት የታቀዱ የሞት ፍርድ አፈፃፀሞችን ያገደ ሲሆን፣ የክልሉ የእስር ቤቶች ሃላፊም ከስልጣናቸው እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriibaa du'aa kan murteeffamte Christa Pike, guyyaa murtiin du'aa itti raawwatame keemikaalli du'aa ishee keessa galus lubbuun hafuun ishee dinqisiisaa ta'eera. Ogeeyyoonni yaalaa fi seeraa akka jedhanitti, namni yeroo keemikaalli ajjeesu qaama isaa keessa galu fayye hin jiru, kanaafuu kun seenaa keessatti kan jalqabaati. Mudannoo kanaan walqabatee mootummaan naannoo Tennessee raawwii adabbii du'aa waggaa kanaaf guyyoota hafan hunda dhaabuu isaa fi itti gaafatamaan mana hidhaa naannichaa hojii gadhiisuu isaa beekameera.

title: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows
english: Researchers in India have discovered that the Himalayan monal pheasant is being forced to change its natural song to communicate over increasing human noise. Additionally, expanding tourism and construction are pushing these birds to higher altitudes as their original habitats become overcrowded. These behavioral and habitat shifts serve as a concerning indicator of how human activity is destabilizing the fragile ecosystem of the Himalayas.
amharic: በህንድ የሚገኙ ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የሂማላያ የሞናል ወፎች በሰው ሰራሽ ጫጫታ ምክንያት የመግባቢያ ድምፃቸውን ለመቀየር ተገደዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በቱሪዝም እና በግንባታ ስራዎች መጨመር ምክንያት ወፎቹ ወደ ተራራው ከፍተኛ ቦታዎች እንዲሸሹ ተደርገዋል። ይህ የባህሪ እና የመኖሪያ ቦታ ለውጥ በሂማላያ ስስ ስነ-ምህዳር ላይ የሰዎች እንቅስቃሴ እያሳደረ ያለውን አሉታዊ ተፅእኖ ያሳያል።
oromo: Qorattoonni Indiyaa keessatti argaman akka hubatanitti, simbirroon 'monal' jedhamtu kan Himalaya keessa jiraattu, sagalee namootaan uumamu mo'achuuf jecha sagalee ishee jijjiirrachuuf dirqamteetti. Kana malees, babal'achuu turistii fi ijaarsawwan garaagaraa simbirroowwan kun akka iddoo isaanii gadhiisanii gara gaara olka'aatti baqatan godheera. Jijjiirramni amalaa fi iddoo jireenyaa kun miidhaa hojiin namootaa uumama Himalaya irratti geessisaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: ‘We are desperate’: Venezuela’s power cuts fuel growing public anger
english: Venezuela is experiencing severe and frequent power outages that have disrupted daily life and essential healthcare services. Citizens are increasingly frustrated by these persistent blackouts, leading to widespread public protests against the government's management of the situation. Many people are questioning how such a resource-rich nation has fallen into a state of total energy instability, leaving residents without basic relief or reliable services.
amharic: ቬኔዙዌላ ከፍተኛ እና ተደጋጋሚ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እያጋጠማት ሲሆን ይህም የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮንና የጤና አገልግሎቶችን በእጅጉ እየጎዳ ይገኛል። እነዚህን ችግሮች መቋቋም ያቃታቸው ዜጎች በመንግስት ላይ ያላቸውን ተቃውሞ በመግለጽ ጎዳና ላይ በመውጣት ድምፃቸውን እያሰሙ ነው። ሀገሪቱ በሃብት የበለፀገች ብትሆንም በሃይል አቅርቦት እጦት ውስጥ መውደቋ ህዝቡን ክፉኛ እያበሳጨና አሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ጥሎታል።
oromo: Veenezueelaa keessatti rakkoon humna ibsaa cimaan guyyuu mudachaa jiraachuun isaa jireenya hawaasaa fi tajaajila fayyaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Hawaasni rakkoo kana to’achuu kan hin dandeenye mootummaa irratti mormii guddaa dhageessisaa jira. Biyyattiin qabeenya uumamaa hedduu kan qabdu ta’us, hanqina ibsaa kanaan rakkoo keessa galuun ishee lammiilee hedduu aarsaa fi yaaddoo keessa galcheera.

title: Christa Pike lawyers say she is speaking one week after failed execution
english: Christa Pike has regained consciousness and begun speaking nearly a week after a failed lethal injection attempt by the state of Tennessee. Although she is receiving medical care for severe injuries to her arms, she remains shackled in her hospital bed. This rare survival case has reignited significant public debate regarding the ethics and reliability of the death penalty in the United States.
amharic: ክሪስታ ፓይክ በቴነሲ ግዛት በተፈጸመባት ያልተሳካ የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸም ከአንድ ሳምንት በኋላ ንቃተ ህሊናዋን መልሳ ማውራት ጀምራለች። በእጆቿ ላይ የደረሰባትን ከባድ ጉዳት በሆስፒታል እየታከመች ቢሆንም፣ በሆስፒታል አልጋ ላይ በሰንሰለት ታስራ እንደምትገኝ ጠበቆቿ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ያልተለመደ ክስተት በአሜሪካ የሞት ፍርድ አሰጣጥ ሥርዓት ላይ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Krista Paayik mootummaa Tenesii biratti adaba du'aa ishee irratti raawwatamuun osoo hin milkaa'in hafe torban tokko booda, fayyitee dubbachuu jalqabdeetti. Miidhaa harka ishee irratti irra ga'een walqabatee hospitaala keessatti gargaarsa fayyaa kan argachaa jirtu yoo ta'u, amma iyyuu siree ishee irra hidhamtee akka jirtu abukaatonni ishee ibsaniiru. Namni tokko adaba akkanaa keessa ooluun isaa biyyattii keessatti adeemsa adaba du'aa irratti falmii guddaa kaasuu danda'eera.

title: Fans flood Buenos Aires ahead of Messi’s final international match
english: Thousands of supporters have gathered at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires to witness Lionel Messi's last international appearance. The legendary captain and record-breaking scorer is retiring from national team duties after 21 years of service. He believes it is now the right moment to pass the torch to the next generation of Argentine players.
amharic: የሊዮኔል ሜሲን የመጨረሻ የአለም አቀፍ ጨዋታ ለመታደም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደጋፊዎች በቦነስ አይረስ በሚገኘው ሞኑሜንታል ስታዲየም ተገኝተዋል። የዓለም ዋንጫ አሸናፊው እና የአርጀንቲና የምንግዜም ከፍተኛ ግብ አስቆጣሪ ለ21 ዓመታት የዘለቀውን የብሔራዊ ቡድን ቆይታውን በይፋ ሊያጠናቅቅ ነው። አሁን ለቀጣዩ ትውልድ ቦታ ለመልቀቅ ትክክለኛው ጊዜ እንደደረሰ ተጫዋቹ ገልጿል።
oromo: Deeggartootni kumaatamaan lakkaa’aman tapha Liionel Meesii kan biyyoolessa isa dhumaa ilaaluuf buufata istaadiyeemii Monumantaal kan Bu'eenoos Ayiresitti argamu guutaniiru. Kabajamaan fi kabajamaa taphataa biyya Arjantiinaa kan ta'e Meesiin, waggaa 21 booda taphuma isa dhumaa booda biyyoolessaaf taphachuu dhaabuuf murteesseera. Innis yeroon kun dhaloota haaraaf iddoo gadhiisuuf kan ga'e ta'uu dubbateera.

title: Houthis, Saudi-led forces claim victories as Yemen fighting rages on
english: Fighting has intensified in Yemen as both Houthi rebels and Saudi-led coalition forces report gains in the ongoing conflict. Houthi militants recently targeted airports in Saudi Arabia, while the coalition retaliated with airstrikes and asserted that they have secured control over the Bab al-Mandeb strait. Despite these counterclaims, the Houthi leadership insists they still hold their previously captured territories.
amharic: በየመን እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት የሁቲ አማጽያን እና የሳዑዲ ጥምረት ኃይሎች በየፊናቸው ድል እንደተቀዳጁ በመግለጽ ውጊያው ተባብሷል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የአየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘሩ ሲሆን፣ ጥምረት ኃይሉም በአየር ድብደባ ምላሽ ከመስጠቱ ባለፈ የባብ አል-ማንደብ ወሽመጥን መቆጣጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሁቲ አመራሮች በበኩላቸው ቀደም ሲል የተቆጣጠሯቸውን ቦታዎች አሁንም በቁጥጥራቸው ስር እንዳሉ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Gonkoota Yemenitti walitti bu'iinsi hammaataa dhufeen, gareen Huthitii fi waraanni Sa'uudii hogganamu hundi injifannoo argachuu isaanii ibsachaa jiru. Huthitiin buufataalee xiyyaaraa Sa'uudii irratti haleellaa kan raawwatan yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin waraanni gamtaa sun haleellaa qilleensaatiin deebii kennanii fi daandii galaana Bab al-Mandeb toannoo isaanii jala galchuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hogganoonni Huthitiin lafa kanaan dura qabatanii turan ammas guutummaatti toannoo isaanii jala jiraachuu isaa jabeessanii dubbatu.

title: Harry Kane equals England record, scores twice in 3-0 win over Czechia
english: Harry Kane celebrated his 125th appearance for England by scoring two goals in a 3-0 victory against Czechia in the UEFA Nations League. With this milestone, he equaled Peter Shilton’s record for the most appearances by a male player for the national team. England controlled the match throughout, starting with an own goal from a Czech defender followed by Kane's clinical finishes.
amharic: ሃሪ ኬይን ለእንግሊዝ ብሄራዊ ቡድን በ125ኛ ጨዋታው ላይ በመሰለፍ ሪከርዱን የደገመ ሲሆን በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ከቼክ ሪፐብሊክ ጋር በተደረገው ጨዋታ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ቡድኑን 3-0 በሆነ ውጤት እንዲያሸንፍ አስችሏል። በዚህ ጨዋታ ኬይን ከዚህ ቀደም በፒተር ሺልተን ተይዞ የነበረውን የእንግሊዝ የወንዶች ብሄራዊ ቡድን የብዛት ጨዋታ ሪከርድ እኩል አድርጓል። እንግሊዝ በመጀመሪያ በቼክ ተከላካይ በተቆጠረ የራሱ ግብ መሪነትን የወሰደች ሲሆን ኬይን ባስቆጠራቸው ሁለት ተጨማሪ ግቦች ድሏን አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Haarii Keeniin tapha isaa 125ffaa garee biyyaalessaa Ingilizii irratti hirmaachuun riikardii biyyattii qixxeessera. Tapha UEFA Nations League kan ta'e kana irratti, Keeniin goolii lama lakkoofsisee gareen isaa Czechia 3-0 akka injifatu taasiseera. Kunis riikardii Piiyter Shiiltiin qabatee ture waliin kan qixxaatudha. Ingilizoonni taphicha haala gaariin hooggananii, goolii ofitti galchuun duraan booda gooliiwwan Keeniin lakkoofsise kanaan injifannoo argataniiru.
